items.title_en: Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State Officially Established in Seattle
items.title_zh: 华盛顿州中国总商会在西雅图正式成立
items.body_en:
On June 8, 2016, which coincided with the Dragon Boat Festival in China, the Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State (CCCWA) held its inauguration ceremony in Seattle.

The Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State is a non-profit organization voluntarily initiated by a group of Chinese-invested enterprises based in Washington State. Its founding board members represent sectors including finance, telecommunications, technology, aviation, real estate, and biopharmaceuticals. The Chamber's preparation process spanned over three months and received strong support from the Chinese Consulate General in San Francisco, the Washington State government, and the city governments of Seattle, Bellevue, and Tacoma from the very beginning. It also received assistance and positive responses from local friendly chambers of commerce and businesses.

On the evening of the inauguration ceremony, Consul General Luo Linquan of the Chinese Consulate General in San Francisco, Mr. Brian Bonlender, Director of the Washington State Department of Commerce, Seattle Mayor Ed Murray, Tacoma Mayor Marilyn Strickland, former U.S. Ambassador to China Gary Locke, and Bellevue City Councilmember and former Mayor Conrad Lee all attended the event and delivered speeches to express their congratulations.

In his speech, Consul General Luo Linquan pointed out that the establishment of the Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State holds great significance, as it will create a new platform for exchange among Chinese enterprises, the Chinese community, and people from all walks of life in the state. Consul General Luo also expressed his hopes for the Chamber's future development, advising it to leverage its strengths by providing high-quality and efficient services and organizing a variety of activities to promote mutually beneficial cooperation between enterprises of the two countries.

Ms. Zhou Honghua, Chairwoman of the Chamber, also stated that after the establishment of the Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State, the organization will maximize the strengths of its members while actively cooperating with other institutions. It will host various activities that serve its member companies and promote commercial and investment exchanges between the two regions.

The Washington State Director of Commerce, the Mayor of Seattle, Mr. Gary Locke, and others also expressed their congratulations on the establishment of the association.

Director Brian Bonlender greeted everyone in fluent Chinese and introduced the progress of various business collaborations between Washington State and China.

Mayor Murray also shared with everyone his many insights from his recently concluded trip to China in May, looking ahead to the tremendous potential for future cooperation between Seattle and China that this visit had revealed. He also announced a number of specific projects and initiatives. Everyone present expressed their heartfelt best wishes for the future development of the association.

The event was also attended by representatives from local friendly chambers of commerce and various business leaders. Everyone gathered together to celebrate this new development in the local Chinese community, while also deepening mutual understanding and friendship. Following the inauguration ceremony, the Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State plans to organize a series of cross-border and local events to effectively serve the interests of its members, strengthen interaction with the local community, and contribute to the development of Chinese-invested enterprises in Washington State as well as to bilateral economic exchanges between the two countries.
items.body_zh:
2016年6月8日，适逢中国时间端午佳节，华盛顿州中国总商会

(Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State, 即CCCWA) 在西雅图举行了成立仪式。


华盛顿州中国总商会是由一批位于华盛顿州的中资企业自愿发起成立的非营利组织，创始理事会成员单位包括金融、通讯、科技、航空地产和医疗制药等领域。商会筹备历时三个多月，从开始即得到了来自旧金山总领馆，华盛顿州政府以及西雅图、贝尔维尤和塔科马市政府的大力支持，并得到了本地各友好商会、企业的帮助和响应。

成立仪式活动当晚，中国驻美国旧金山总领馆罗林泉总领事，华盛顿州商务厅厅长Brian Bonlender先生，西雅图市市长穆雷先生，塔科马市长史蒂克兰德女士，美国前驻华大使骆家辉先生，以及贝尔维尤前华人市长、现任议员李瑞麟先生都前来出席并致辞祝贺。

罗林泉总领事在致辞中指出，华盛顿州中国商会成立具有非常重要的意义，将为在华州的广大中国企业、华人，以及当地各界人士搭建一个新的交流平台。罗总领事同时对商会的工作发展提出了希望，指导商会发挥自身的优势，通过提供优质高效的服务，举办形式多样的活动，促进两国企业互利合作。

总商会主席周红华女士也表示，华州中国总商会成立以后，将最大限度地发挥会员自身长处，同时积极与其他机构进行合作，举办各种服务于会员单位、促进两地商贸投资的活动。

华州商务厅长、西雅图市长和骆家辉先生等也都对协会的成立表达了的祝贺。

厅长Brian Bonlender用熟练的中文和大家问好，并介绍了华州和中国在商务领域的多方面合作进展。

穆雷市长更是和大家分享了5月份刚刚结束的中国之行的诸多体会，展望了这次行程所展现出的未来西雅图和中国巨大的合作潜力，也公布了很多具体项目和措施。大家都对协会未来的发展表示了衷心的祝福。

活动当晚到场的还包括本地友好商会、各企业领导代表，大家欢聚一堂，共庆这一本地华人社区新发展的同时，也加深了彼此的了解和友谊。成立仪式后，华州中国总商会计划筹备一系列跨境、本地活动，切实服务会员利益，加强和本地社区的互动，为中资企业在华州的发展和两国双边经济往来贡献力量。

items.title_en: Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State Opens Membership Recruitment
items.title_zh: 华盛顿州中国总商会开放会员招募
items.body_en:
On June 8th of this year, the Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State (CCCWA) was officially inaugurated in Seattle on the occasion of the Dragon Boat Festival. The Chamber is a non-profit organization voluntarily initiated by Chinese-invested enterprises in Washington State, aiming to promote investment and trade cooperation between China and Washington State, and to support and assist more Chinese enterprises in making investments in the United States. Its board members represent key sectors including finance, telecommunications, technology, aviation, real estate, and biomedicine.

The establishment of the Chamber has received strong support from the Chinese Consulate General in San Francisco, the Washington State government, the city governments of Seattle, Tacoma, and Bellevue, as well as various sectors across Washington State.

After several months of intensive preparation, the Chamber has officially opened its membership recruitment to the public. Membership is open to chambers of commerce, associations, organizations, enterprises, and individuals both in the United States and abroad. The recruitment period is scheduled from August 8th to September 30th. However, due to limited registered member spots, the recruitment may end earlier than scheduled.

Member benefits upon joining the Chamber include, but are not limited to:

  • Assistance with invitation letters, itinerary planning, arrangements, and local reception for overseas members visiting Washington State.

  • Regular communication with the Washington State government to keep members informed of relevant policies and incentives for attracting foreign investment and businesses.

  • Periodic seminars covering finance, law, taxation, company operations, human resources, immigration law, visas, team management, and other fields.

  • Organized events for Washington State companies to explore investment opportunities in China and for Chinese companies to invest in the U.S., including business matching activities.

  • Regular networking events and annual galas.

  • Assistance with passport and visa-related matters.

  • And more.

Interested companies, enterprises, and individuals are invited to complete the membership application form through our WeChat official account.
items.body_zh:
华盛顿州中国总商会于今年六月八号端午佳节在西雅图正式挂牌成立。本商会是由在华盛顿州的中资企业自愿发起组成的非营利性组织，旨在促进中国和美国华盛顿州投资贸易合作，支持和帮助更多的中资企业对美投资。其理事会成员单位涵盖了金融，通讯，科技，航空，地产以及生物医药等主要领域。


商会的成立，得到了中国驻旧金山总领事馆，华盛顿州政府，西雅图、塔科马和贝尔维尤等市政府以及华盛顿州各界的大力支持。


经过几个月的紧张筹备，总商会终于开放了对外正式招募成员。会员招募面向美国本土以及海外各商会、协会、组织、企业以及个人，本次招募计划从8月8号开始到9月30号结束。由于注册会员的名额限制，招募活动有可能提前结束。


商会成员单位在加入商会后可获得的福利包括但不限于：

• 商会将协助海外会员办理来华州访问交流的邀请、行程设计、安排和当地接待；
• 商会会定期与华盛顿州政府沟通，帮助成员了解华州吸引外资、外商的有关政策及优惠；
• 商会将不定期举办金融、法律、税务、公司运营、人力资源、移民法、签证、团队管理等不同领域的讲座；
• 商会将举办华州的企业去华投资、中资企业来美投资等走出去寻找商机、企业配对等活动；
• 商会将定期举办Networking活动、年会；
• 商会将协助会员办理护照、签证等事务；
• 其他
 

有意向加入的公司，企业及个人，请进入我们的微信公众号完成入会申请表格。

items.title_en: CCCWA "Seattle Forum" Episode 10: The Culture, History, and Tasting of Wine
items.title_zh: 华盛顿州中国总商会“西雅图大讲坛”第10期: 葡萄酒的文化,历史和品鉴
items.body_en:
At the beginning of the new year, the Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State (CCCWA) organized the 10th episode of the "Seattle Forum." The event was hosted by a chamber member and Chairman of GIYA International, who held a small New Year wine tasting gathering to share knowledge about wine.

Headquartered in Seattle, Washington, GIYA International presented high-quality wines from Washington State, including wines used for official state banquets at the White House. The GIYA team provided guests with a detailed introduction to wine varieties and explained the differences between Old World and New World wines. The Chairman of GIYA also shared practical knowledge on wine etiquette, the steps of wine tasting, flavor profiles, food and wine pairing, and the collectible value of wine.

During the wine tasting, the chamber provided guests with both red and white wines from traditional producing countries (Old World) such as France and Italy, as well as from New World countries such as the United States, Australia, New Zealand, and Chile, allowing guests to expand their appreciation through on-site tasting. Under the guidance of professionals, everyone shared their experiences tasting the different flavors of Old World and New World wines and savored their rich quality.

The event was held at the lake-view office of IsoftStone and Vestlink, both chamber member companies. During the event, participants engaged in in-depth interactions, learning about wine knowledge to enhance their quality of life while also strengthening mutual understanding among chamber members.
items.body_zh:
新年伊始，华盛顿州中国总商会组织举办了第十期“西雅图大讲坛”。商会会员、吉雅国际公司董事长为大家举办了迎接”2018“小型新年品酒会，分享红酒知识。


总部设在美国华盛顿州西雅图，吉雅国际（GIYA）带来了华盛顿州的优质佳酿，特别是美国白宫元首国宴招待用酒。 吉雅向来宾详尽介绍了葡萄酒的种类，解释了旧世界和新世界葡萄酒的区别等专业领域信息。吉雅董事长同时分享葡萄酒礼仪，品酒的步骤和品鉴的口感层次，以及酒餐搭配，红酒的收藏价值等等实用知识。


品酒会上，商会为来宾提供了法国、意大利等传统酿造国（旧世界）和美国、澳大利亚、新西兰、智利等（新世界）的干红和干白让大家现场品茗增加认知。大家在专业人士的引导下一起分享品鉴旧世界和新世界葡萄酒不同的口味、细尝浓郁的品质。


本次活动在商会会员IsoftStone、Vestlink公司的湖景办公室举行。活动中大家进行了深层互动，学习红酒知识提高生活品质的同时，加深了会员间的相互了解。

During the wine tasting, the chamber provided guests with both red and white wines from traditional producing countries (Old World) such as France and Italy, as well as from New World countries such as the United States, Australia, New Zealand, and Chile, allowing guests to expand their appreciation through on-site tasting. Under the guidance of professionals, everyone shared their experiences tasting the different flavors of Old World and New World wines and savored their rich quality.

The event was held at the lake-view office of IsoftStone and Vestlink, both chamber member companies. During the event, participants engaged in in-depth interactions, learning about wine knowledge to enhance their quality of life while also strengthening mutual understanding among chamber members.
content_blocks.zh:
新年伊始，华盛顿州中国总商会组织举办了第十期“西雅图大讲坛”。商会会员、吉雅国际公司董事长为大家举办了迎接”2018“小型新年品酒会，分享红酒知识。


总部设在美国华盛顿州西雅图，吉雅国际（GIYA）带来了华盛顿州的优质佳酿，特别是美国白宫元首国宴招待用酒。 吉雅向来宾详尽介绍了葡萄酒的种类，解释了旧世界和新世界葡萄酒的区别等专业领域信息。吉雅董事长同时分享葡萄酒礼仪，品酒的步骤和品鉴的口感层次，以及酒餐搭配，红酒的收藏价值等等实用知识。


品酒会上，商会为来宾提供了法国、意大利等传统酿造国（旧世界）和美国、澳大利亚、新西兰、智利等（新世界）的干红和干白让大家现场品茗增加认知。大家在专业人士的引导下一起分享品鉴旧世界和新世界葡萄酒不同的口味、细尝浓郁的品质。


本次活动在商会会员IsoftStone、Vestlink公司的湖景办公室举行。活动中大家进行了深层互动，学习红酒知识提高生活品质的同时，加深了会员间的相互了解。

items.title_en: The Fourth Anniversary Celebration of the Seattle Real Estate Investment Club, a Governing Member of CCCWA
items.title_zh: CCCWA理事单位西雅图地产投资俱乐部成立四周年庆典
items.body_en:
On October 26, 2019, the Seattle Real Estate Investment Club, a governing member of CCCWA, held its fourth anniversary celebration. The guests attending the celebration included not only many club members but also member friends from the Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State (CCCWA), the 808 Golf Club, the Seattle Entrepreneurship Club, and other organizations.

The Seattle Real Estate Club was established in 2015 as a non-profit organization registered in the State of Washington. Its members consist of real estate investors, development and management companies, design firms, attorneys, accountants, real estate brokers, and professionals from various sectors of the real estate industry. Over the four years since its founding, members have voluntarily formed partnerships through the club's platform and have successfully invested in multiple commercial real estate projects.

The celebration was co-hosted by Ms. Li Xiaoyan and Ms. Zhang Xiaohong, co-chairs of the Seattle Real Estate Investment Club. During the event, several members shared their achievements and insights gained over the past year.

The Seattle Real Estate Investment Club is also actively involved in community public welfare initiatives. On the day of the celebration, Attorney Cai Qing introduced the Eastside Art Center public benefit project.

The entire celebration was conducted in a friendly and warm atmosphere. The guests who participated in the event expressed that they greatly enjoyed the occasion and were grateful for the opportunity to make new friends and business partners through the fourth anniversary of the Seattle Real Estate Investment Club. They all extended their best wishes for the continued growth and success of both the Seattle Real Estate Investment Club and the CCCWA (Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State), hoping that these platforms will continue to provide quality support and services to their members.
items.body_zh:
2019年10月26日，CCCWA理事单位西雅图地产投资俱乐部举行了成立四周年庆典活动。参加此次庆典活动的嘉宾除了众多俱乐部会员以外，还有来自华盛顿州中国总商会（CCCWA），808高尔夫球俱乐部，西雅图创业协会等协会和单位的会员朋友们。


西雅图房地产俱乐部成立于2015年，是在华盛顿州注册成立的非盈利机构；其会员由房地产投资人、开发管理公司、设计公司、律师、会计师、房地产经纪人以及地产专业上下游从业人士组成。俱乐部成立四年以来，会员们已经在其平台上自愿组合，成功投资了多个商业地产项目。

 

西雅图地产投资俱乐部轮值主席李晓艳女士、张小红女士共同主持此次庆典。庆典活动过程中，多位会员分享了在过去一年中取得的成就和收获的心得。

西雅图房地产投资俱乐部还积极参与社区公益事业，庆典当日蔡清律师介绍了东区艺术中心公益项目。

整场庆典活动在友好和热烈的气氛下进行，参与庆典的嘉宾们纷纷表示很享受也很感谢能够通过西雅图房地产投资俱乐部成立四周年这个契机结交到新朋友和商业合作伙伴。共同祝愿西雅图房地产投资俱乐部和华盛顿州中国总商会（CCCWA）协会平台越办越好，为会员朋友们持续提供优质帮助与服务。

items.title_en: CCCWA Delegation Travels to California to Participate in China-U.S. Agricultural Resource Matching Forum
items.title_zh: CCCWA代表团赴加州参加中美农业资源对接论坛活动
items.body_en: On November 19, 2019, a delegation from the Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State (CCCWA) participated in the China-U.S. Agricultural Resource Matching and Food Safety Policy Exchange Forum in Sacramento. The forum was jointly organized by the Chinese Consulate General in San Francisco, the California Department of Food and Agriculture, and the City of Sacramento Government. The forum aimed to strengthen experience and policy exchanges between California and China regarding food safety, promote agricultural trade between the two regions, and build bridges for people-to-people and cultural exchanges. Commercial Counselor Yang Yihang of the Chinese Consulate General in San Francisco attended the forum. The Director of the California Department of Food and Agriculture, members of the California State Legislature, and the Senior Advisor for International Affairs and Trade at the Governor's Office of Business and Economic Development (GoBiz) presented on California's agricultural development and its agricultural trade with China. Dr. Wang, a food safety policy expert from the University of California, Davis, was invited to share insights on California's food safety policies and implementation. The forum also facilitated business matching activities between major California agricultural producers and Chinese enterprises. Following the forum, the delegation was invited to conduct on-site visits to local businesses.
items.body_zh: 2019年11月19日，华盛顿州中国总商会代表团在萨克拉门托市参与了由中国驻旧金山总领馆、美国加州商务厅、萨克拉门托市政府联合举办的中美农业资源对接及食品安全政策交流论坛。此次论坛旨在加强加州与中国双方食品安全相关经验与政策交流、促进加州与中国农业产品贸易交流、并为加州与中国的人文交流搭建桥梁。中国驻旧金山总领馆杨依杭商务参赞参与此次论坛。加州农业厅厅长、加州议会议员、加州州长商业和经济发展办公室（GoBiz）国际事务和贸易高级顾问介绍了加州农业发展情况和加州与中国农业贸易情况。加州大学戴维斯分校食品安全政策专家王博士受邀介绍了加州食品安全政策和执行情况。此次交流论坛针对加州主要农产品生产企业与中资企业开展了业务对接活动。论坛结束后代表团受邀赴当地企业进行了实地考察。

items.title_en: CCCWA Delegation Visits San Francisco
items.title_zh: CCCWA代表团访问旧金山
items.body_en:
On November 18, 2019, a delegation from CCCWA (Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State) visited San Francisco to hold talks with the China Enterprise Association of Northern California (CEA).

Mr. Kang Jiande, President of the China Enterprise Association of Northern California and Head of the Western U.S. Market at Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (USA), introduced the development of the association. Mr. Kang noted that CEA currently has 197 member companies, spanning multiple industries including finance, real estate, transportation, telecommunications, technology, logistics, law, new energy, and media. The association has established six specialized committees: the Real Estate Committee, Finance Committee, New Energy Committee, High-Tech Committee, Urban Institutions Alliance, and Infrastructure Committee. The association is dedicated to providing services to Chinese enterprises in Northern California and the broader consular district, building platforms for communication and exchange, and continuously enhancing its influence in the local community.

Mr. Zhang Zailing, former General Manager of China Youth Travel Service USA and a two-term former President of CEA, along with Mr. Liu Yang, President of the Bank of Communications San Francisco Branch and a member representative, shared their insights on the governance and development of CEA as a non-profit organization. Member representatives from both sides engaged in in-depth discussions on topics such as the development of Chinese enterprises in the U.S., the organization of membership activities for non-profits, and resource sharing among Chinese-American entrepreneurs in the Seattle and San Francisco regions.

Ms. Lili Lv, President of CCCWA, introduced the organization's background and future development direction. She expressed the hope that CCCWA and CEA could pursue cross-regional collaboration in the future, jointly leverage their respective influence, further establish a positive image for Chinese enterprises, and contribute to the development of U.S.-China economic and trade relations through tangible efforts.

On that day, a delegation from the Washington State Chinese Chamber of Commerce (CCCWA) and the Seattle Real Estate Investment Club also visited the headquarters of Propriis Real Estate Development Company, where they held an exchange and discussion forum with the Silicon Valley Dunes Real Estate Investment Club.

During the forum, Mr. Carlson Chan, President of Propriis Real Estate Development Company, presented the projects currently under development and management by his company. Ms. Ocean Pan, CEO of the Silicon Valley Dunes Real Estate Investment Club, introduced the club's background and operations. The participants engaged in in-depth discussions on hot topics in real estate investment and development, including land prices, capital costs, and development cost control. Ms. Lili Lv, President of CCCWA (Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State), introduced two high-end apartment projects—The Emerald and Mira Flats—currently being developed by Create World America Real Estate Inc. She also presented development land acquisition projects in Bellevue and near the University of Washington, which were led by Create World America Real Estate Fund, from the perspective of investment return analysis. Local developers and investors from the San Francisco area expressed strong interest in real estate projects in the Greater Seattle area, believing that land prices in the region still have significant room for appreciation, and voiced their hope to visit the Greater Seattle area for future investment opportunities. The two clubs agreed to hold their next resource-matching symposium in Seattle.
items.body_zh:
2019年11月18日，CCCWA华盛顿州中国总商会代表团一行到访旧金山与北加州中国企业协会进行会谈。
 
北加州中国企业协会会长、中国工商银行（美国）美西市场负责人康建德先生介绍了北加州中国企业协会的发展。康建德先生提到，北加州中国企业协会目前共有会员企业197家，涉及金融、地产、交通、通讯、科技、物流、律所、新能源、传媒等多个行业，下设6大专业委员会：房地产委员会、金融委员会、新能源委员会、高科技委员会、城市机构联盟以及基础设施委员会。协会致力于为北加州及领区中国企业提供服务，搭建沟通和交流平台，不断提升协会在当地的影响力。
 
曾在北加州中国企业协会担任两任会长的美国中青旅总经理张再龄先生和会员单位代表交通银行旧金山分行行长刘洋先生，分享了关于北加州中国企业协会作为非营利组织治理与发展的管理心得。双方会员代表就中国企业在美发展、非营利组织的会员活动组织、西雅图与旧金山两个城市的华裔企业家资源共享等问题进行了深度的沟通交流。
 
CCCWA华盛顿州中国总商会会长吕莉莉女士介绍了华盛顿州中国总商会的基本情况和未来发展方向，希望未来能与北加州中国企业协会跨区域联合发展，共同发挥各自影响，进一步树立中国企业良好形象，以实实在在的工作，为中美两国经贸关系发展贡献力量。

当日，华盛顿州中国总商会及西雅图房地产投资俱乐部代表团还到访Propriis房地产开发公司总部，并在这里与硅谷沙丘地产投资俱乐部进行了交流座谈。
 
座谈会上，Propriis房地产开发公司总裁Carlson Chan先生介绍了公司正在开发管理的项目。硅谷沙丘地产投资俱乐部首席执行官Ocean Pan女士介绍了沙丘地产投资俱乐部的基本情况，大家对房地产投资及开发过程中的土地价格、资金成本、开发成本控制等热点问题进行了深度交流。CCCWA华盛顿州中国总商会会长吕莉莉女士介绍了拓宏美国开发管理公司正在开发中的The Emerald及Mira Flats两个高端公寓项目，也从投资回报分析的角度介绍了拓宏美国房地产基金主导收购的Bellevue开发土地、华盛顿大学开发土地等项目。旧金山当地的开发商及投资人均表示对大西雅图地区的房地产项目有浓厚的兴趣，认为大西雅图地区的土地价格仍有较大的上涨空间，希望未来有机会到大西雅图地区考察投资。两个俱乐部约定将在西雅图举行下次双方资源对接座谈会。

北加州中国企业协会会长、中国工商银行（美国）美西市场负责人康建德先生介绍了北加州中国企业协会的发展。康建德先生提到，北加州中国企业协会目前共有会员企业197家，涉及金融、地产、交通、通讯、科技、物流、律所、新能源、传媒等多个行业，下设6大专业委员会：房地产委员会、金融委员会、新能源委员会、高科技委员会、城市机构联盟以及基础设施委员会。协会致力于为北加州及领区中国企业提供服务，搭建沟通和交流平台，不断提升协会在当地的影响力。
 
曾在北加州中国企业协会担任两任会长的美国中青旅总经理张再龄先生和会员单位代表交通银行旧金山分行行长刘洋先生，分享了关于北加州中国企业协会作为非营利组织治理与发展的管理心得。双方会员代表就中国企业在美发展、非营利组织的会员活动组织、西雅图与旧金山两个城市的华裔企业家资源共享等问题进行了深度的沟通交流。
 
CCCWA华盛顿州中国总商会会长吕莉莉女士介绍了华盛顿州中国总商会的基本情况和未来发展方向，希望未来能与北加州中国企业协会跨区域联合发展，共同发挥各自影响，进一步树立中国企业良好形象，以实实在在的工作，为中美两国经贸关系发展贡献力量。

content_blocks.caption_zh: 华盛顿州中国总商会与北加州中国企业协会进行会谈

content_blocks.en:
On that day, a delegation from the Washington State Chinese Chamber of Commerce (CCCWA) and the Seattle Real Estate Investment Club also visited the headquarters of Propriis Real Estate Development Company, where they held an exchange and discussion forum with the Silicon Valley Dunes Real Estate Investment Club.

During the forum, Mr. Carlson Chan, President of Propriis Real Estate Development Company, presented the projects currently under development and management by his company. Ms. Ocean Pan, CEO of the Silicon Valley Dunes Real Estate Investment Club, introduced the club's background and operations. The participants engaged in in-depth discussions on hot topics in real estate investment and development, including land prices, capital costs, and development cost control. Ms. Lili Lv, President of CCCWA (Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State), introduced two high-end apartment projects—The Emerald and Mira Flats—currently being developed by Create World America Real Estate Inc. She also presented development land acquisition projects in Bellevue and near the University of Washington, which were led by Create World America Real Estate Fund, from the perspective of investment return analysis. Local developers and investors from the San Francisco area expressed strong interest in real estate projects in the Greater Seattle area, believing that land prices in the region still have significant room for appreciation, and voiced their hope to visit the Greater Seattle area for future investment opportunities. The two clubs agreed to hold their next resource-matching symposium in Seattle.
content_blocks.zh:
当日，华盛顿州中国总商会及西雅图房地产投资俱乐部代表团还到访Propriis房地产开发公司总部，并在这里与硅谷沙丘地产投资俱乐部进行了交流座谈。
 
座谈会上，Propriis房地产开发公司总裁Carlson Chan先生介绍了公司正在开发管理的项目。硅谷沙丘地产投资俱乐部首席执行官Ocean Pan女士介绍了沙丘地产投资俱乐部的基本情况，大家对房地产投资及开发过程中的土地价格、资金成本、开发成本控制等热点问题进行了深度交流。CCCWA华盛顿州中国总商会会长吕莉莉女士介绍了拓宏美国开发管理公司正在开发中的The Emerald及Mira Flats两个高端公寓项目，也从投资回报分析的角度介绍了拓宏美国房地产基金主导收购的Bellevue开发土地、华盛顿大学开发土地等项目。旧金山当地的开发商及投资人均表示对大西雅图地区的房地产项目有浓厚的兴趣，认为大西雅图地区的土地价格仍有较大的上涨空间，希望未来有机会到大西雅图地区考察投资。两个俱乐部约定将在西雅图举行下次双方资源对接座谈会。

items.title_en: CCCWA Foundation Officially Launches Donation Channel to Combat COVID-19
items.title_zh: 华盛顿州中国总商会基金会抗击新冠捐赠通道正式启动
items.body_en:
As COVID-19 continues to spread across the globe, the number of confirmed cases and deaths in Washington State has been rising sharply day by day. Frontline hospitals fighting the pandemic—such as Evergreen Hospital, Overlake Hospital, Swedish Hospital, and Seattle Children's Hospital—are facing severe shortages of basic protective supplies, including masks and hand sanitizer.

To support community public health and address the urgent needs of frontline medical institutions, the CCCWA Foundation (Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State Foundation) swiftly established a donation working group to coordinate resources from all sectors of society. They also issued donation appeals to Chamber member companies, alumni associations, and other organizations, urging collective efforts to overcome this challenging time.

On March 20, the very day the donation channel was officially launched, the CCCWA Foundation received a donation from its member company Systimmune Inc., which included 2,000 3M N95 masks, 2,000 medical-grade masks, 400 goggles, and 100 protective gowns. That same afternoon, the donations were delivered to Everett Providence Hospital and Overlake Medical Center.


Donation channels are now open. Information on donors, items donated, quantities, and distribution details will be transparently announced on an ongoing basis.

Please stay tuned for updates on the CCCWA Foundation's donation campaign.

"Every drop of water joins to form a river; every modest effort helps the community."

随着新冠肺炎蔓延全球，华盛顿州的确诊与死亡人数逐日剧增。一线抗疫医院如 Evergreen Hospital, Overlake hospital, Swedish hospital, Seattle Children’s hospital等都出现了口罩、洗手液等基本防护用品严重紧缺的情况。


为支援社区公共卫生，解一线医疗机构的燃眉之急，华盛顿州中国总商会基金

(CCCWA Foundation)紧急成立捐款工作组，争分夺秒沟通社会各界资源，并向商会会员企业、校友会等机构发出捐赠倡议，共克难关。


3月20日，在捐赠通道正式启动当日，CCCWA Foundation就收到会员单位Systimmune Inc/百利药业捐赠的2000个3M N95口罩、2000个医用级别口罩、400个护目镜以及100套防护服。并已于当日下午前往Everett Providence Hospital以及Overlake medical center进行了捐赠。

捐赠通道已经开启，捐赠者、捐赠物及数量及受赠明细都将陆续透明公布给大家。

items.body_en:
The Novel Coronavirus (COVID-19), recognized as an unprecedented global threat, is raging around the world and causing major crisis. According to CDC data, the number of diagnoses and deaths in Washington State has increased sharply, which became the second highest number compared to other states just within half a month.


As the pandemic continues to evolve, major hospitals, children’s hospitals and healthcare facilities are running out of essential supplies, including medical masks and hand sanitizers.


Support from the communities is highly essential in terms of collaboration inorder to mitigate the risk of infection.It is the high time for the community and the

medical professionals work together to defend public health.


CCCWA FOUNDATION dedicated to promote Chinese Americans communities involvement. The goal is to make resources available to support local hospitals and life care centers.


As we can see, during the past few months, many first generation of immigrants work tirelessly to support their families and friends in the homeland. But now is the time again to support the land we dwell and love. We want to contribute to the planning and recovery.


CCCWA FOUNDATION is calling for donation and all types of support from members and friends. With plan, determination and action, we can move mountains.


For Monetary Donation:

1. BOA Zelle Quick Pay to CCCWA Foundation

2020 年这场猝不及防的新型冠状病毒 COVID-19 正在肆虐全球，而我们所处的华盛顿州 确诊病例数量在短短的半个月内就排到了美国第二。随着疫情不断扩大，目前西雅图地区 口罩、洗手液等防护刚需用品严重匮乏。一线医护工作者们都将面临被感染的危险，许多 医院已向社会各界发出公告寻求支援。


此刻，物资短缺的困局已实实在在地发生在我们身边，如果不能及时改善局面，这将会 给医疗资源、社区安全带来沉重的打击。华盛顿州中国总商会基金会(以下称 CCCWA FOUNDATION )作为连接在美中资企业/在美华商及服务社区的纽带，正在争分夺秒联 络社会各界资源，希望尽吾之所能支援一线医院及社区的防护抗灾工作，解西雅图各大医 院、老年中心的燃眉之急。


CCCWA FOUNDATION 特此倡议各会员单位及社区热心人士众志成城。滴水可汇江， 薪火可燎原，让我们为吾之社区各尽其能，为吾之医护人员担当后盾，为弱势群体遮风挡雨，为吾生活之土地齐心协力!

items.title_en: CCCWA March 26 Event Preview: Cultural Differences and Communication Between Chinese and American Enterprises | "Weekly Star" Live Webcast
items.title_zh: CCCWA 3月26日活动预告：中美企业文化的差异与沟通 ｜“每周一星” 网络直播活动
items.body_en:
As the two largest economies in the world, China and the United States are seeing increasingly frequent economic and social exchanges. Consequently, political and economic frictions, as exemplified by the trade war, are also on the rise. So, what should we pay attention to in terms of cross-cultural communication when working, living, starting a business, or doing business in the United States?

For this episode of CCCWA's (Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State) "Weekly Star" series, we have specially invited Mr. Xia Yinglin, who has extensive work and entrepreneurial experience in multiple countries around the world, including China, Japan, Canada, and the United States, to give a special presentation on "Cultural Differences and Communication Between Chinese and American Enterprises." Mr. Xia will systematically share his insights on what constitutes good and effective communication in American culture, covering topics such as culture and personality, teamwork, in-person meetings vs. conference calls, and how to write emails and work reports. We hope that Mr. Xia's insightful lecture will be of great help to everyone in their work and daily lives in the United States.

Mr. Xia Yinglin received his Master's degree in Computer Science from Beijing Jiaotong University in 1987.

Before starting his entrepreneurial career, he worked as a software engineer at the Ministry of Railways in China, at Tokyo Systems Laboratories in Japan, at DATT Japan in Vancouver, Canada, as a software localization engineer at SimulTrans in Mountain View, USA, as a senior localization engineer at Adobe Systems in San Jose, USA, as a senior localization engineer at Netscape in Mountain View, USA, as a software localization engineer at Microsoft in Redmond, USA, and as Director of Product Globalization Services at hiSoft Technology International Limited in Seattle, USA.

Every Thursday evening 7:00–9:00 PM (Pacific Time)
(Beijing Time: Every Friday morning 10:00 AM–12:00 PM)

items.body_zh:
中美作为世界上两个最大的经济体，经济社会交往越来越频繁。随之而来，以贸易战为代表的政治经济摩擦也越来越多。那么我们在美国工作、生活以及创业、营商过程中，在跨文化沟通方面有什么需要注意的吗？

本期CCCWA华盛顿州中国总商会 “每周一星“的做客嘉宾，我们特别邀请了在中国、日本、加拿大、美国等世界多个国家都有丰富工作和创业经验的夏映林先生，为大家专题分享《中美企业文化的差异与沟通》。夏先生将从文化与个性、团队合作、面对面会议和电话会议，如何写电子邮件和工作报告等几个方面，为大家系统分享他理解的什么是好的和有效的美国文化沟通。希望夏先生的精彩讲座对大家在美工作和生活带来帮助。

夏映林先生于1987年获得北京交通大学计算机科学硕士学位。
创业前，他曾在中国铁道部任软件工程师，在日本东京Tokyo Systems Laboratories任软件工程师，在加拿大温哥华DATT Japan任软件工程师，在美国山景城SimulTrans任软件本地化工程师，在美国圣何塞Adobe Systems任高级本地化工程师，在美国山景城Netscape任高级本地化工程师，在美国雷德蒙德微软任软件本地化工程师，在美国西雅图hiSoft Technology International Limited任产品全球化服务总监。

items.title_en: The First Episode of CCCWA's "Weekly Star" Hotline Is Now Live! Mr. Xia Yinglin Gives a Special Presentation on "Cultural Differences and Communication Between Chinese and American Enterprises."
items.title_zh: 首期CCCWA“每周一星“热线开播！夏映林先生为大家专题分享《中美企业文化的差异与沟通》
items.body_en:
The CCCWA Weekly Video Sharing series officially launched on March 23. Member companies and business representatives from both domestic and international locations shared professional knowledge and introduced their company products and services through the online platform.

For the first episode of CCCWA's (Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State) "Weekly Star" series, we specially invited Mr. Xia Yinglin, who has extensive work and entrepreneurial experience in multiple countries around the world, including China, Japan, Canada, and the United States, to give a special presentation on "Cultural Differences and Communication Between Chinese and American Enterprises." Mr. Xia systematically shared his insights on what constitutes good and effective communication in American culture, covering topics such as culture and personality, teamwork, in-person meetings vs. conference calls, and how to write emails and work reports. He also answered practical questions regarding cross-cultural communication and business collaboration between China and the U.S.

The professionals shared their extensive work experience and practical case studies, promptly addressing questions raised by participants. Nearly 40 online attendees gained valuable insights from multiple perspectives. Everyone greatly looks forward to CCCWA continuing to host various specialized seminars in the future, so that they can stay informed with the latest industry updates from professionals. CCCWA hopes to connect with more members and provide a platform for exchange, sharing, and collaboration, working together towards a win-win year in 2020!
items.body_zh:
CCCWA 每周视频分享于3月23日正式开播了，会员单位和海内外的企业代表通过网络平台分享专业知识、介绍公司产品与服务。

专业人士结合丰富的工作经历和实际案例的分享，及时解答了参会者提出的一些疑问， 近40位在线参会人员受到多方面的启发。大家非常期待CCCWA今后继续举办各类专题讲座， 以便获得专业人士提供的最新业内信息 。CCCWA 希望能了解更多会员，为大家提供交流、分享、合作的平台、共赢2020年！

items.title_en: CCCWA Love Lunch Fundraising Initiative to Fight the Pandemic
items.title_zh: CCCWA抗击疫情爱心午餐募捐倡议书
items.body_en:
The COVID-19 pandemic has become a global disaster facing all of humanity. In our second home, Washington State, there is now an urgent shortage of medical supplies such as masks and protective gowns. Many restaurants have closed, while frontline healthcare workers are working under overwhelming strain, often without even having time to eat.

At this time of an unprecedented crisis not seen in a century, CCCWA (Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State), together with multiple organizations, has once again launched a public welfare initiative—this time to provide free love lunches to frontline healthcare workers, following earlier efforts to raise funds and procure medical supplies.

CCCWA will unite multiple organizations and mobilize resources from all sectors to select safe and reliable restaurants and food delivery companies. All production and transportation will strictly comply with Washington State food safety standards to ensure that nutritious and delicious meal boxes reach healthcare workers. In terms of staffing, donation channels, and the use of funds, all procedures will strictly adhere to U.S. laws and regulations governing charitable donations. All meals procured will be coordinated through close communication with local medical institutions at all levels, maintaining point-to-point contact with recipient hospitals.

This event is led by The Dolar Shop (in partnership with Asian Family Market) and IJ Sushi Burrito, with the following commitments:

  1. The Dolar Shop, in partnership with Asian Family Market, pledges USD 120,000 worth of meals.

  2. The Dolar Shop independently pledges an additional USD 84,000 worth of meals.

  3. IJ Sushi Burrito pledges USD 108,000 worth of meals.

  4. Chowbus Inc. pledges professional delivery services valued at USD 30,000.

Recipient organizations already contacted include: UW Virology, Swedish Hospital, Overlake Hospital, and Evergreen Hospital.

This initiative plans to raise USD 400,000 within one month to prepare 30,000 love meals, which will be delivered to healthcare workers at medical institutions, community service personnel, and community members in need.

Encouragingly, even before the official call for donations was issued, Attorney Cai Qing of Cai & Cai Associates and Ms. Sylvia Chin had already done extensive groundwork in the early stages of the event. The Washington State Chinese Chamber of Commerce has already received over USD 10,000 in cash donations from individuals and businesses, including Li Ruoyao and Zhang Shuo of Jing Wei LLC, as well as other corporate donors. Additionally, The Dolar Shop and IJ Sushi Burrito have already been providing free love lunches to people from all walks of life for a week, with an overwhelmingly positive response.

The Washington State Chinese Chamber of Commerce (CCCWA) calls upon more restaurants, institutions, companies, and individuals to join this initiative and help provide assistance to more healthcare workers and community members in need. Our fundraising campaign is fully open and transparent, strictly complies with U.S. laws, and operates in accordance with the financial regulations for non-profit organizations. Both the amount of donations received and the food contributed will be announced in real time.

Though oceans and mountains separate us, we share the same sky and the same moon. We love our homeland thousands of miles away, and we also love the land beneath our feet. To our fellow community members in Washington State, let us cheer for our second home—this is where we live and work, and this is the fertile ground where our children grow up healthy and happy. Now, we must stand together with all ethnic groups in America, united in our efforts to fight the pandemic. We will do our utmost to give back to the community and express our love and dedication as Chinese Americans to our second home. May heaven bestow its mercy and grant us peace; may the world be safe and humanity live in harmony.

Let us all take action! It is not the size of the donation that matters, but the willingness to give. Let us demonstrate through our concrete actions the courage and responsibility of all communities standing together in the fight against the pandemic!

items.body_zh:
目前新冠病毒已成为全世界人民共同面对的灾难。我们生活居住的第二故乡华盛顿州开始出现口罩、防护服等医用物品告急。很多饭店歇业，一线医护人员超负荷工作，甚至连饭都没时间吃。

值此百年不遇之危难时刻，CCCWA华盛顿州中国总商会等多家机构在募捐采购医用物资活动之后再次发起为一线医护人员免费配送爱心午餐的公益活动。


CCCWA将联合多家机构、发动各界力量，挑选安全可靠的餐饮企业和食品配送企业，严格按照华州食品安全标准生产和运输，将营养美味的爱心便当送到医护人员手上；在人员调配上，在受赠渠道上，在善款使用上，均严格遵守美国捐赠法律的规定。所采购食品，均通过与本地各级医疗机构密切沟通后，与受赠医院保持点对点联系。

此活动由豆捞坊中餐厅（联合百家超市）和IJ Sushi Burrito日餐厅领捐：1，豆捞坊联合百佳超市认捐价值12万美金,  2，豆捞坊独自额外认捐价值8.4万美金。3，IJ Sushi Burrito认捐价值10.8万美金。4, Chowbus Inc 专业配送服务认捐价值3万美金。目前已联系好的的受赠单位包括：UW Virology 华大病毒实验室、Swedish Hospital 瑞士医院、Overlake Hospital 欧弗莱克医院、Evergreen Hospital 长青医院。


此活动计划在一个月内募集40万美元，制作3万份爱心午餐，送到医疗机构的医护人员、社区服务人员及需要救助的社区成员手里。可喜的是，在倡议书尚未发出之际，蔡和蔡律师事务所的蔡清律师和Sylvia Chin女士在活动初期做了大量的工作，华盛顿总商会已收到美国经纬有限公司李若垚、张硕夫妇及其他企业个人捐赠的超过1万美金现金，豆捞坊和IJ Sushi Burrito已为社会各界提供了一周的免费爱心午餐，反响热烈。

华盛顿州中国总商会倡议更多的餐饮企业加入进来，倡议更多的机构、公司和个人加入进来，为更多的医护人员和社区里需要救助的群体提供帮助。我们的募捐活动完全公开透明，严格遵守美国法律，且严格按照非营利机构的财务规定运作，捐款数目和捐助食品都将实时公布。 


山川异域，风月同天。我们爱万里之遥的祖国，也爱脚下的这片土地。华州的父老乡亲们，让我们为第二故乡加油，这里是我们工作生活的家园，这里是我们的孩子健康成长的乐土。现在，我们需要和美国的各族裔站在一起，齐心协力、共同抵抗疫情。我们尽最大的努力，回馈社区，表达我们美国华人对第二故乡的爱和奉献。愿天降怜爱，赐予太平；愿世界安好，人类祥和。


大家行动起来吧！爱心不在大小，数额不在多少，让我们以实际行动表达我们各族裔民众共抗疫情，共同担当的勇气和责任！

content_blocks.en: The COVID-19 pandemic has become a global disaster facing all of humanity. In our second home, Washington State, there is now an urgent shortage of medical supplies such as masks and protective gowns. Many restaurants have closed, while frontline healthcare workers are working under overwhelming strain, often without even having time to eat.
content_blocks.zh: 目前新冠病毒已成为全世界人民共同面对的灾难。我们生活居住的第二故乡华盛顿州开始出现口罩、防护服等医用物品告急。很多饭店歇业，一线医护人员超负荷工作，甚至连饭都没时间吃。

content_blocks.en:
At this time of an unprecedented crisis not seen in a century, CCCWA (Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State), together with multiple organizations, has once again launched a public welfare initiative—this time to provide free love lunches to frontline healthcare workers, following earlier efforts to raise funds and procure medical supplies.

CCCWA will unite multiple organizations and mobilize resources from all sectors to select safe and reliable restaurants and food delivery companies. All production and transportation will strictly comply with Washington State food safety standards to ensure that nutritious and delicious meal boxes reach healthcare workers. In terms of staffing, donation channels, and the use of funds, all procedures will strictly adhere to U.S. laws and regulations governing charitable donations. All meals procured will be coordinated through close communication with local medical institutions at all levels, maintaining point-to-point contact with recipient hospitals.
content_blocks.zh:
值此百年不遇之危难时刻，CCCWA华盛顿州中国总商会等多家机构在募捐采购医用物资活动之后再次发起为一线医护人员免费配送爱心午餐的公益活动。


CCCWA将联合多家机构、发动各界力量，挑选安全可靠的餐饮企业和食品配送企业，严格按照华州食品安全标准生产和运输，将营养美味的爱心便当送到医护人员手上；在人员调配上，在受赠渠道上，在善款使用上，均严格遵守美国捐赠法律的规定。所采购食品，均通过与本地各级医疗机构密切沟通后，与受赠医院保持点对点联系。

content_blocks.en:
This event is led by The Dolar Shop (in partnership with Asian Family Market) and IJ Sushi Burrito, with the following commitments:

  1. The Dolar Shop, in partnership with Asian Family Market, pledges USD 120,000 worth of meals.

  2. The Dolar Shop independently pledges an additional USD 84,000 worth of meals.

  3. IJ Sushi Burrito pledges USD 108,000 worth of meals.

  4. Chowbus Inc. pledges professional delivery services valued at USD 30,000.

Recipient organizations already contacted include: UW Virology, Swedish Hospital, Overlake Hospital, and Evergreen Hospital.

This initiative plans to raise USD 400,000 within one month to prepare 30,000 love meals, which will be delivered to healthcare workers at medical institutions, community service personnel, and community members in need.

Encouragingly, even before the official call for donations was issued, Attorney Cai Qing of Cai & Cai Associates and Ms. Sylvia Chin had already done extensive groundwork in the early stages of the event. The Washington State Chinese Chamber of Commerce has already received over USD 10,000 in cash donations from individuals and businesses, including Li Ruoyao and Zhang Shuo of Jing Wei LLC, as well as other corporate donors. Additionally, The Dolar Shop and IJ Sushi Burrito have already been providing free love lunches to people from all walks of life for a week, with an overwhelmingly positive response.
content_blocks.zh:
此活动由豆捞坊中餐厅（联合百家超市）和IJ Sushi Burrito日餐厅领捐：1，豆捞坊联合百佳超市认捐价值12万美金,  2，豆捞坊独自额外认捐价值8.4万美金。3，IJ Sushi Burrito认捐价值10.8万美金。4, Chowbus Inc 专业配送服务认捐价值3万美金。目前已联系好的的受赠单位包括：UW Virology 华大病毒实验室、Swedish Hospital 瑞士医院、Overlake Hospital 欧弗莱克医院、Evergreen Hospital 长青医院。


此活动计划在一个月内募集40万美元，制作3万份爱心午餐，送到医疗机构的医护人员、社区服务人员及需要救助的社区成员手里。可喜的是，在倡议书尚未发出之际，蔡和蔡律师事务所的蔡清律师和Sylvia Chin女士在活动初期做了大量的工作，华盛顿总商会已收到美国经纬有限公司李若垚、张硕夫妇及其他企业个人捐赠的超过1万美金现金，豆捞坊和IJ Sushi Burrito已为社会各界提供了一周的免费爱心午餐，反响热烈。

content_blocks.en:
The Washington State Chinese Chamber of Commerce (CCCWA) calls upon more restaurants, institutions, companies, and individuals to join this initiative and help provide assistance to more healthcare workers and community members in need. Our fundraising campaign is fully open and transparent, strictly complies with U.S. laws, and operates in accordance with the financial regulations for non-profit organizations. Both the amount of donations received and the food contributed will be announced in real time.

Though oceans and mountains separate us, we share the same sky and the same moon. We love our homeland thousands of miles away, and we also love the land beneath our feet. To our fellow community members in Washington State, let us cheer for our second home—this is where we live and work, and this is the fertile ground where our children grow up healthy and happy. Now, we must stand together with all ethnic groups in America, united in our efforts to fight the pandemic. We will do our utmost to give back to the community and express our love and dedication as Chinese Americans to our second home. May heaven bestow its mercy and grant us peace; may the world be safe and humanity live in harmony.

Let us all take action! It is not the size of the donation that matters, but the willingness to give. Let us demonstrate through our concrete actions the courage and responsibility of all communities standing together in the fight against the pandemic!
content_blocks.zh:
华盛顿州中国总商会倡议更多的餐饮企业加入进来，倡议更多的机构、公司和个人加入进来，为更多的医护人员和社区里需要救助的群体提供帮助。我们的募捐活动完全公开透明，严格遵守美国法律，且严格按照非营利机构的财务规定运作，捐款数目和捐助食品都将实时公布。 


山川异域，风月同天。我们爱万里之遥的祖国，也爱脚下的这片土地。华州的父老乡亲们，让我们为第二故乡加油，这里是我们工作生活的家园，这里是我们的孩子健康成长的乐土。现在，我们需要和美国的各族裔站在一起，齐心协力、共同抵抗疫情。我们尽最大的努力，回馈社区，表达我们美国华人对第二故乡的爱和奉献。愿天降怜爱，赐予太平；愿世界安好，人类祥和。


大家行动起来吧！爱心不在大小，数额不在多少，让我们以实际行动表达我们各族裔民众共抗疫情，共同担当的勇气和责任！

items.title_en: Fighting the Pandemic – Love Restaurant Series: The Dolar Shop "One Pot Contains One World – Yesterday, People Helped Me; Today, I Help Others"
items.title_zh: 抗击疫情，爱心餐厅系列介绍之“豆捞坊”：一锅一世界-昨日人渡我，今日我渡人
items.body_en:
Initiated by the Washington State Chinese Chamber of Commerce (CCCWA) and led by The Dolar Shop and IJ Sushi Burrito, the "Love Lunch Fundraising Campaign to Fight the Pandemic" has received enthusiastic responses from the Seattle restaurant community. As of the evening of April 2, in addition to The Dolar Shop and IJ Sushi Burrito, four more restaurants—Imperial Garden (Yiyuan), Chengdu Memory (Rongcheng Old Hot Pot), Flying Fish (Futuro Fish), and Liuyishou Hot Pot—had joined the effort to donate love lunches. Together, they have pledged to provide 14,150 meals, and have already prepared and delivered 1,515 love lunches to healthcare workers at medical institutions, community service personnel, and community members in need.

When asked about the original aspiration behind initiating the "Love Lunch Fundraising Campaign to Fight COVID-19," the manager of The Dolar Shop Seattle location gave a very concise response: "One pot contains one world: Yesterday, people helped me; today, I help others." I understand his message to mean that since entering the Seattle market in October 2018, the community's support and patronage have sustained the business. Now, at a time when the COVID-19 pandemic is severe in the United States and restaurants have been forced to close, The Dolar Shop still wishes to do something for the local community in return for the kindness and support it has received over the past year and a half. That is why The Dolar Shop decided to provide free love lunches to all those in need in the community. The entire staff of The Dolar Shop has demonstrated through their actions the spirit of gratitude embodied in the saying: "Yesterday, people helped me; today, I help others."

Food is the first necessity of the people. Under quarantine measures, many restaurants have closed, leaving police officers, community workers, healthcare workers, taxi drivers, those working and studying from home, and elderly people without care all facing difficulties in obtaining meals. Initially, The Dolar Shop Seattle location voluntarily donated love lunches, and anyone in need could come to the restaurant to pick up a free meal. However, perhaps due to limited word-of-mouth or people not believing such a good thing could be true, not many came forward to claim the free lunches. Later, the Washington State Chinese Chamber of Commerce learned of this situation and proactively reached out to other nonprofit organizations in the Greater Seattle area to connect with hospital systems and more restaurants, delivering love lunches to frontline healthcare workers fighting the pandemic and benefiting more people in need.

As a Buddhist saying goes: "One flower contains a world, one tree contains a lifetime, one blade of grass contains a heaven, one leaf contains a Tathagata, one grain of sand contains a realm of bliss, one land contains a pure ground, one smile contains a karmic connection, and one thought contains tranquility." The Dolar Shop has also put forward its own philosophy: "One pot contains a world." With individual hot pots, dining is cleaner and more hygienic, and everyone can choose their own flavors and ingredients while still gathering around the same table, enjoying delicious food and lively conversation. People often have to wait in line for up to two hours just to enjoy their favorite Dolar Shop hot pot.

What is the story behind the Dolar Shop brand? According to the restaurant's representative, the concept of Dolar (Doulao) originated in Macau. In the past, when people couldn't afford high-quality ingredients, seafood was made into smooth, minced pastes (known as "slides")—delicious, affordable, and beloved by the people of Macau. The name "Doulao" is also a homophone for "everyone scoops up" in Chinese, symbolizing good fortune and prosperity, and bringing good luck. Later, Macau-style Doulao spread to mainland China and became synonymous with luxury, high-end hot pot dining, often chosen for business banquets.

With so many hot pot brands out there, what makes The Dolar Shop unique? The restaurant's representative explained that hot pot can generally be divided into two categories: Sichuan-style spicy hot pot and Hong Kong-style seafood hot pot. The Dolar Shop belongs to the Hong Kong-style category, using the freshest seafood to make "slides," selecting the highest quality beef, and pairing it with secret house-made sauces. After the meal, diners can also enjoy a nourishing bowl of hot pot broth. The Dolar Shop is a premium hot pot brand, using only the best ingredients available—because great ingredients lead to great flavors. The restaurant also features cutting-edge interior design and top-notch service, always putting the guest first. The Dolar Shop also pays great attention to the back-of-house operations that guests don't see, even requiring the copper pipes in the drainage system to be polished to a brilliant shine. It is precisely because of this high standard of quality consistency that, since its founding in Shanghai in 2004, The Dolar Shop has grown to 52 directly owned locations worldwide, including four overseas locations in Seattle, New York, Vancouver, and Sydney.

We sincerely thank all the staff at The Dolar Shop for their initiative in giving back to the community and helping during the most difficult times for the restaurant industry amid the pandemic. We wholeheartedly wish The Dolar Shop a long and prosperous future as a century-old institution and a global brand! Best wishes to The Dolar Shop!

The Washington State Chinese Chamber of Commerce (CCCWA) calls upon more restaurants, institutions, companies, and individuals to join this initiative and help provide assistance to more healthcare workers and community members in need. Our fundraising campaign is fully open and transparent, strictly complies with U.S. laws, and operates in accordance with the financial regulations for non-profit organizations. Both the amount of donations received and the food contributed will be announced in real time.

Let us all take action! It is not the size of the donation that matters, but the willingness to give. Let us demonstrate through our concrete actions the courage and responsibility of all communities standing together in the fight against the pandemic!

由华盛顿州中国总商会CCCWA发起倡议，豆捞坊中餐厅、IJ Sushi Burrito日餐厅领捐的“抗击疫 情爱心午餐募捐活动” 得到了⻄雅图餐饮届的热烈响应。至4月2日晚，除了豆捞坊和IJ Sushi Burrito日餐 厅，又有颐和园、蓉城老火锅、沸腾⻥乡、刘一手等4家餐厅新加入到捐赠爱心午餐的队伍中来，承诺捐 赠午餐14,150份，并已制作完成1,515份爱心午餐，送到医疗机构的医护人员、社区服务人员及需要救助的 社区成员手中。


当被问到为什么主动发起“抗击新冠疫情爱心午餐”捐赠活动的初心时，豆捞坊⻄雅图分店负责人回答非常 简洁:“一锅一世界:昨日人渡我，今日我渡人。” 我理解他的意思是，自2018年10月进入⻄雅图以来，人 们的喜爱支撑了企业的发展。当今正直美国新冠疫情严重，饭店被迫关店歇业之时，豆捞坊仍然希望能为 当地社区做些什么，以回馈社区一年半以来的厚爱。所以，豆捞坊决定向社区所有需要的人免费提供爱心 午餐。豆捞坊全体员工以实际行动表达“昨日人渡我，今日我渡人”的感恩。


⺠以⻝为天，疫情隔离之下，很多饭店关⻔，导致警察、社区工作人员、医护人员、出租⻋司机、居家工 作和学习的人们、无人照料的老人都遇到了吃饭问题。最初豆捞坊⻄雅图店自愿捐献爱心午餐，任何需要 的人都可以到店里领取一份免费爱心午餐。可能是因为传播有限，或者人们并不相信有这样的好事，来主 动领取爱心午餐的人并不多。后来华盛顿州中国总商会了解到这个情况，主动联系大⻄雅图地区其他公益 组织联系医院系统以及更多的饭店，为冲在抗疫救灾第一线的医护人员送上爱心午餐，让更多需要的人受益。

佛曰:一花一世界，一木一浮生，一草一天堂，一叶一如来，一砂一极乐，一方一净土，一笑一尘缘，一 念一清静。豆捞坊也提出了自己的理念:一锅一世界。每人一锅，更干净卫生，每个人都可以选择自己的 口味和菜品，大家又都聚在一个餐桌上，一边品味美⻝，一边谈笑⻛生。人们甚至常常要排2小时的队才能吃到心爱的豆捞火锅。


豆捞坊品牌背后有什么样的故事呢?据豆捞坊负责人介绍豆捞的概念来自澳⻔，以前人们吃不起好的⻝ 材，就把海鲜做成滑类，这样既美味又便宜实惠，很受澳⻔人⺠的喜爱。而且豆捞的谐音是“都捞”，寓意 吉祥富贵，也能讨个好口彩。后来，澳⻔豆捞传到大陆，成了奢侈高端火锅的代名词，商务宴请的重要选择。
火锅品牌众多，豆捞坊有什么自己的特色呢?豆捞坊负责人介绍，火锅大致可以分为两类，四川麻辣火锅 和港式海鲜火锅。豆捞就属于港式火锅，用最新鲜的海鲜做成滑类，选择最高品质的牛肉，配以秘制酱 料，吃完还可以喝滋补的火锅靓汤。豆捞坊是高端火锅，选用的都是能 找到的最好的⻝材，⻝材好，味道才能更好。豆捞坊的装修也是最超前的，服务也是最好的， 永远把客人放在第一位。豆捞坊还很注意在客人看不到的后厨下功夫，连 下水道的铜管都要求擦得铮明瓦亮。正因为豆捞坊对品质一致性的高要 求，自2004年在上海创立品牌至今，豆捞坊在全世界开了52家分店都是直营，其中海外有四家店，分别在 ⻄雅图、纽约、温哥华和悉尼。


衷心感谢豆捞坊全体同仁在疫情之下餐饮业最艰难的时刻，仍然主动回馈社会，帮助社区。衷心祝愿豆捞 坊成为百年老店，世界品牌!祝福豆捞!

content_blocks.en:
Initiated by the Washington State Chinese Chamber of Commerce (CCCWA) and led by The Dolar Shop and IJ Sushi Burrito, the "Love Lunch Fundraising Campaign to Fight the Pandemic" has received enthusiastic responses from the Seattle restaurant community. As of the evening of April 2, in addition to The Dolar Shop and IJ Sushi Burrito, four more restaurants—Imperial Garden (Yiyuan), Chengdu Memory (Rongcheng Old Hot Pot), Flying Fish (Futuro Fish), and Liuyishou Hot Pot—had joined the effort to donate love lunches. Together, they have pledged to provide 14,150 meals, and have already prepared and delivered 1,515 love lunches to healthcare workers at medical institutions, community service personnel, and community members in need.

When asked about the original aspiration behind initiating the "Love Lunch Fundraising Campaign to Fight COVID-19," the manager of The Dolar Shop Seattle location gave a very concise response: "One pot contains one world: Yesterday, people helped me; today, I help others." I understand his message to mean that since entering the Seattle market in October 2018, the community's support and patronage have sustained the business. Now, at a time when the COVID-19 pandemic is severe in the United States and restaurants have been forced to close, The Dolar Shop still wishes to do something for the local community in return for the kindness and support it has received over the past year and a half. That is why The Dolar Shop decided to provide free love lunches to all those in need in the community. The entire staff of The Dolar Shop has demonstrated through their actions the spirit of gratitude embodied in the saying: "Yesterday, people helped me; today, I help others."

Food is the first necessity of the people. Under quarantine measures, many restaurants have closed, leaving police officers, community workers, healthcare workers, taxi drivers, those working and studying from home, and elderly people without care all facing difficulties in obtaining meals. Initially, The Dolar Shop Seattle location voluntarily donated love lunches, and anyone in need could come to the restaurant to pick up a free meal. However, perhaps due to limited word-of-mouth or people not believing such a good thing could be true, not many came forward to claim the free lunches. Later, the Washington State Chinese Chamber of Commerce learned of this situation and proactively reached out to other nonprofit organizations in the Greater Seattle area to connect with hospital systems and more restaurants, delivering love lunches to frontline healthcare workers fighting the pandemic and benefiting more people in need.

由华盛顿州中国总商会CCCWA发起倡议，豆捞坊中餐厅、IJ Sushi Burrito日餐厅领捐的“抗击疫 情爱心午餐募捐活动” 得到了⻄雅图餐饮届的热烈响应。至4月2日晚，除了豆捞坊和IJ Sushi Burrito日餐 厅，又有颐和园、蓉城老火锅、沸腾⻥乡、刘一手等4家餐厅新加入到捐赠爱心午餐的队伍中来，承诺捐 赠午餐14,150份，并已制作完成1,515份爱心午餐，送到医疗机构的医护人员、社区服务人员及需要救助的 社区成员手中。


当被问到为什么主动发起“抗击新冠疫情爱心午餐”捐赠活动的初心时，豆捞坊⻄雅图分店负责人回答非常 简洁:“一锅一世界:昨日人渡我，今日我渡人。” 我理解他的意思是，自2018年10月进入⻄雅图以来，人 们的喜爱支撑了企业的发展。当今正直美国新冠疫情严重，饭店被迫关店歇业之时，豆捞坊仍然希望能为 当地社区做些什么，以回馈社区一年半以来的厚爱。所以，豆捞坊决定向社区所有需要的人免费提供爱心 午餐。豆捞坊全体员工以实际行动表达“昨日人渡我，今日我渡人”的感恩。


⺠以⻝为天，疫情隔离之下，很多饭店关⻔，导致警察、社区工作人员、医护人员、出租⻋司机、居家工 作和学习的人们、无人照料的老人都遇到了吃饭问题。最初豆捞坊⻄雅图店自愿捐献爱心午餐，任何需要 的人都可以到店里领取一份免费爱心午餐。可能是因为传播有限，或者人们并不相信有这样的好事，来主 动领取爱心午餐的人并不多。后来华盛顿州中国总商会了解到这个情况，主动联系大⻄雅图地区其他公益 组织联系医院系统以及更多的饭店，为冲在抗疫救灾第一线的医护人员送上爱心午餐，让更多需要的人受益。

content_blocks.en:
As a Buddhist saying goes: "One flower contains a world, one tree contains a lifetime, one blade of grass contains a heaven, one leaf contains a Tathagata, one grain of sand contains a realm of bliss, one land contains a pure ground, one smile contains a karmic connection, and one thought contains tranquility." The Dolar Shop has also put forward its own philosophy: "One pot contains a world." With individual hot pots, dining is cleaner and more hygienic, and everyone can choose their own flavors and ingredients while still gathering around the same table, enjoying delicious food and lively conversation. People often have to wait in line for up to two hours just to enjoy their favorite Dolar Shop hot pot.

What is the story behind the Dolar Shop brand? According to the restaurant's representative, the concept of Dolar (Doulao) originated in Macau. In the past, when people couldn't afford high-quality ingredients, seafood was made into smooth, minced pastes (known as "slides")—delicious, affordable, and beloved by the people of Macau. The name "Doulao" is also a homophone for "everyone scoops up" in Chinese, symbolizing good fortune and prosperity, and bringing good luck. Later, Macau-style Doulao spread to mainland China and became synonymous with luxury, high-end hot pot dining, often chosen for business banquets.

With so many hot pot brands out there, what makes The Dolar Shop unique? The restaurant's representative explained that hot pot can generally be divided into two categories: Sichuan-style spicy hot pot and Hong Kong-style seafood hot pot. The Dolar Shop belongs to the Hong Kong-style category, using the freshest seafood to make "slides," selecting the highest quality beef, and pairing it with secret house-made sauces. After the meal, diners can also enjoy a nourishing bowl of hot pot broth. The Dolar Shop is a premium hot pot brand, using only the best ingredients available—because great ingredients lead to great flavors. The restaurant also features cutting-edge interior design and top-notch service, always putting the guest first. The Dolar Shop also pays great attention to the back-of-house operations that guests don't see, even requiring the copper pipes in the drainage system to be polished to a brilliant shine. It is precisely because of this high standard of quality consistency that, since its founding in Shanghai in 2004, The Dolar Shop has grown to 52 directly owned locations worldwide, including four overseas locations in Seattle, New York, Vancouver, and Sydney.

We sincerely thank all the staff at The Dolar Shop for their initiative in giving back to the community and helping during the most difficult times for the restaurant industry amid the pandemic. We wholeheartedly wish The Dolar Shop a long and prosperous future as a century-old institution and a global brand! Best wishes to The Dolar Shop!

items.title_en: CCCWA Foundation Unites All Sectors of the Community in the Fight Against COVID-19
items.title_zh: 华盛顿州中国总商会基金会联合社会各界积极抗疫
items.body_en:
Since the launch of its donation channel on March 20, the Washington State Chinese Chamber of Commerce Foundation (hereinafter referred to as CCCWA Foundation), in partnership with the Xiamen University Alumni Association in Seattle, the Zhejiang University North America Seattle Alumni Association, and member companies of the Chamber of Commerce, formed a working group. Within just one week, they raised nearly USD 39,000 in cash donations and nearly USD 100,000 worth of supplies from all sectors of the community. On the very day the donation channel was launched, supplies donated by Systimmune Inc. were delivered to Everett Providence Hospital and Overlake Medical Center.

Throughout the fundraising process, the campaign rallied tens of thousands of acts of kindness and demonstrated the unprecedented unity of the Chinese community. As soon as the call for donations was issued, over 100 people joined the CCCWA Foundation donation group. Meanwhile, the Xiamen University Alumni Association in Seattle and the Zhejiang University North America Seattle Alumni Association also mobilized fundraising efforts within their alumni networks, with a total of over 300 participants.

Among the donors were not only Chinese-invested enterprises, renowned entrepreneurs, political figures, and professionals from all walks of life in the Seattle area, but also numerous local institutions, organizations, and caring individuals. Many individuals and organizations had already donated multiple times yet still chose to give again. All these efforts stem from our shared goal and aspiration: to stand united in fighting COVID-19 and protecting our community!

During this challenging period marked by shipping backlogs and disrupted air routes, the CCCWA Foundation working group raced against time to coordinate with various units, ensuring the quality and safety of all supplies. With the assistance of professional trading companies, they managed to deliver materials to the Seattle area as quickly as possible. To date, the CCCWA Foundation has visited 14 institutions and donated 82,000 masks and 1,500 sets of protective supplies (including medical gloves, protective gowns, and goggles), with many more items still in transit. The donations have been met with sincere gratitude and recognition from the recipient organizations, leaving a lasting impression of the Chinese community's unity and solidarity. The campaign was also covered by mainstream media outlets, including KIRO 7 News.

On March 27, the working group delivered supplies to Issaquah Swedish Hospital, where they were handed directly to medical staff in the ICU. The healthcare workers expressed their heartfelt appreciation, saying that this was truly a "life-saving gift in times of need" and thanking the Chinese community for its care and protection.

On March 31, representatives of the CCCWA Foundation working group visited Virginia Mason Medical Center, Fred Hutchinson Cancer Research Center, as well as the Bellevue Police Department and Fire Department to make donations. Gary Kaplan, CEO of Virginia Mason, sent a special letter of thanks to the CCCWA Foundation.

From April 1 to 3, the CCCWA Foundation working group representatives traveled tirelessly to UW Valley Medical Center, Evergreen Hospital, Overlake Medical Center, ICHS International District Medical and Dental Clinic in Chinatown, and Burien Highline Medical Center to make donations. Burien Mayor Jimmy Matta personally wrote a letter to thank the CCCWA Foundation, in which he emotionally wrote: "At a time when COVID-19 is ravaging our community, your help has allowed us to see the light of hope at the end of the tunnel. Our entire community is grateful to you."

The pandemic situation in Washington State is currently stabilizing. This is not only due to the selfless efforts of doctors and the cooperation of all sectors of society, but also because of the collective dedication and support of the entire Chinese community. Many of us are first-generation immigrants. We draw strength from our motherland to support our home here, because we love this land deeply. Every drop of water joins to form a river; every modest effort helps the community. The CCCWA Foundation will continue to unite all sectors of society in making donations until the clarion call of victory sounds in the fight against the pandemic!

(Report by Carrie Wang – CCCWA Foundation)

华盛顿州中国总商会基金会（以下称CCCWA Foundation）捐赠通道自3月20日启动以来，联合厦门大学西雅图校友会（Xiamen University Alumni Association in Seattle）、浙江大学北美西雅图校友会（Zhejiang University North America Seattle Alumni）、总商会会员单位组成工作组，在短短一周内共筹集来自社会各界的资金捐赠近3万9千美金以及价值近10万美金的物资，并在通道启动当天将百利药业（SystimmuneInc）捐赠的物资送达Everett Providence Hospital及Overlake Medical Center.


整个筹款过程一次又一次凝聚了数万的爱心，见证了华人空前的团结。倡议书一经发出就号召聚集了百人加入CCCWA Foundation捐赠群，同时厦门大学西雅图校友会及浙江大学北美西雅图校友会分别在其校友群中进行号召和筹款，总参与人数超过300人。


此次捐赠者中不仅有西雅图地区的中资企业、知名企业家、政要、来自各行各业的精英，还有众多本地机构、组织和爱心人士，其中许多个人和单位已经几度捐款，但依旧再次献出爱心；所有的努力都因为我们有着共同的目标和心愿：团结一心、抗击新冠、保护社区！


在快递爆仓，航路不畅的特殊时期，CCCWA Foundation工作组争分夺秒对接各单位，确保物资的质量及安全性。并在专业外贸公司的协助下尽可能以最高的速度送达西雅图地区。截至日前，CCCWA Foundation共前往14家机构，捐出8万2千个口罩及1500套防护物资（含医用手套、防护服及护目镜）, 仍有大批物品还在运送途中。捐赠得到了受赠单位由衷的感谢和肯定，华人众志成城的形象深入人心，并被主流媒体：如KIRO 7电视频道报道。


3月27日工作组将物资送达Issaquah Swedish Hospital, 并由医院工作人员直接送至ICU的医护手中。医护人员都称这真是雪中送炭，感谢来自中国社区的关爱和保护。

3月31日CCCWA Foundation工作组代表前往Virginia Mason Medical Center、Fred Hutchinson Cancer Research Center及Bellevue市警察局、消防局进行捐赠。Virginia Mason的CEO Gary Kaplan特别发信致谢CCCAW Foundation。

4月1日至3日，CCCWA Foundation工作组代表马不停蹄前往UW Valley Medical Center、Evergreen Hospital、Overlake Medical Center、中国城ICHS International District Medical and Dental Clinic、Burien Highline Medial Center进行捐赠。Burien市长Jimmy Matta亲自致信感谢CCCWA Foundation，并动情地写到：“在新冠病毒COVID-19肆虐我们社区的时候，你们的帮助让我们看到了隧道尽头的希望之光。我们整个社区都感谢你们。”

目前华盛顿州疫情趋于稳定，这不仅因为医生们奋不顾身的努力和社会各界的配合，更因为有整个华人社区一致的奉献与支持。我们中许多人是第一代移民，我们汇聚来自母国的力量共同支援现在的家园，因为我们深爱这片土地。滴水汇江河，绵力助社区。CCCWA Foundation将继续团结社会各界进行捐赠，直到抗疫之战吹响胜利的号角！

content_blocks.en:
Since the launch of its donation channel on March 20, the Washington State Chinese Chamber of Commerce Foundation (hereinafter referred to as CCCWA Foundation), in partnership with the Xiamen University Alumni Association in Seattle, the Zhejiang University North America Seattle Alumni Association, and member companies of the Chamber of Commerce, formed a working group. Within just one week, they raised nearly USD 39,000 in cash donations and nearly USD 100,000 worth of supplies from all sectors of the community. On the very day the donation channel was launched, supplies donated by Systimmune Inc. were delivered to Everett Providence Hospital and Overlake Medical Center.

Throughout the fundraising process, the campaign rallied tens of thousands of acts of kindness and demonstrated the unprecedented unity of the Chinese community. As soon as the call for donations was issued, over 100 people joined the CCCWA Foundation donation group. Meanwhile, the Xiamen University Alumni Association in Seattle and the Zhejiang University North America Seattle Alumni Association also mobilized fundraising efforts within their alumni networks, with a total of over 300 participants.

Among the donors were not only Chinese-invested enterprises, renowned entrepreneurs, political figures, and professionals from all walks of life in the Seattle area, but also numerous local institutions, organizations, and caring individuals. Many individuals and organizations had already donated multiple times yet still chose to give again. All these efforts stem from our shared goal and aspiration: to stand united in fighting COVID-19 and protecting our community!

During this challenging period marked by shipping backlogs and disrupted air routes, the CCCWA Foundation working group raced against time to coordinate with various units, ensuring the quality and safety of all supplies. With the assistance of professional trading companies, they managed to deliver materials to the Seattle area as quickly as possible. To date, the CCCWA Foundation has visited 14 institutions and donated 82,000 masks and 1,500 sets of protective supplies (including medical gloves, protective gowns, and goggles), with many more items still in transit. The donations have been met with sincere gratitude and recognition from the recipient organizations, leaving a lasting impression of the Chinese community's unity and solidarity. The campaign was also covered by mainstream media outlets, including KIRO 7 News.

On March 27, the working group delivered supplies to Issaquah Swedish Hospital, where they were handed directly to medical staff in the ICU. The healthcare workers expressed their heartfelt appreciation, saying that this was truly a "life-saving gift in times of need" and thanking the Chinese community for its care and protection.
content_blocks.zh:
华盛顿州中国总商会基金会（以下称CCCWA Foundation）捐赠通道自3月20日启动以来，联合厦门大学西雅图校友会（Xiamen University Alumni Association in Seattle）、浙江大学北美西雅图校友会（Zhejiang University North America Seattle Alumni）、总商会会员单位组成工作组，在短短一周内共筹集来自社会各界的资金捐赠近3万9千美金以及价值近10万美金的物资，并在通道启动当天将百利药业（SystimmuneInc）捐赠的物资送达Everett Providence Hospital及Overlake Medical Center.


整个筹款过程一次又一次凝聚了数万的爱心，见证了华人空前的团结。倡议书一经发出就号召聚集了百人加入CCCWA Foundation捐赠群，同时厦门大学西雅图校友会及浙江大学北美西雅图校友会分别在其校友群中进行号召和筹款，总参与人数超过300人。


此次捐赠者中不仅有西雅图地区的中资企业、知名企业家、政要、来自各行各业的精英，还有众多本地机构、组织和爱心人士，其中许多个人和单位已经几度捐款，但依旧再次献出爱心；所有的努力都因为我们有着共同的目标和心愿：团结一心、抗击新冠、保护社区！


在快递爆仓，航路不畅的特殊时期，CCCWA Foundation工作组争分夺秒对接各单位，确保物资的质量及安全性。并在专业外贸公司的协助下尽可能以最高的速度送达西雅图地区。截至日前，CCCWA Foundation共前往14家机构，捐出8万2千个口罩及1500套防护物资（含医用手套、防护服及护目镜）, 仍有大批物品还在运送途中。捐赠得到了受赠单位由衷的感谢和肯定，华人众志成城的形象深入人心，并被主流媒体：如KIRO 7电视频道报道。


3月27日工作组将物资送达Issaquah Swedish Hospital, 并由医院工作人员直接送至ICU的医护手中。医护人员都称这真是雪中送炭，感谢来自中国社区的关爱和保护。

Burien Mayor Jimmy Matta personally wrote a letter to thank the CCCWA Foundation, in which he emotionally wrote: "At a time when COVID-19 is ravaging our community, your help has allowed us to see the light of hope at the end of the tunnel. Our entire community is grateful to you."

items.title_en: Update Report on the Love Lunch Fundraising Campaign to Fight the Pandemic
items.title_zh: 抗击疫情，爱心餐募捐活动更新报道
items.body_en:
The "Love Lunch Fundraising Campaign" initiated by the Washington State Chinese Chamber of Commerce (CCCWA) and led by donor restaurants including The Dolar Shop, IJ Sushi Burrito, Imperial Garden (Yiyuan), Chengdu Memory (Rongcheng Old Hot Pot), Flying Fish (Futuro Fish), and Liuyishou Hot Pot has received enthusiastic responses from the Seattle restaurant community. Together, they have pledged to provide a total of approximately 14,150 nutritious meal packages valued at USD 242,250, as an expression of gratitude and respect for the healthcare workers fighting on the front lines of the pandemic.

As of the evening of April 7, despite the severe impact of the pandemic on their businesses, the restaurants participating in this charitable initiative have continued to give generously to contribute to the community. They have funded and arranged staffing to prepare 2,535 love lunches (valued at a total of USD 45,525), which have been delivered to healthcare workers at medical institutions, community service personnel, and community members in need.

The "Love Lunch" initiative is progressing vigorously and in an orderly manner. The event has received enthusiastic support from all sectors of the community, with the total amount of donations growing day by day. CCCWA has already received USD 26,479 in cash donations from caring individuals from all walks of life, who hope to donate more love meals through our platform. In the face of the virus, frontline medical workers have chosen to work day and night to protect our health. It is only fitting that we do our part and show our gratitude to these hard-working healthcare professionals with a heartfelt donation!

Healthcare workers on the front lines of the pandemic at UW Virology, Swedish Hospital, Overlake Hospital, and Evergreen Hospital have already enjoyed the love lunches. Many of them have been deeply grateful upon receiving the meals and have expressed their thanks to CCCWA and the sponsoring restaurants through social media. Healthcare workers at UW Virology posted on Facebook: "These love lunches are absolutely delicious!"

The "Love Lunch" initiative will also be extended to more healthcare workers at additional medical institutions, community service personnel, and community members in need. The freshly prepared, nutritious love meal packages bring us closer to the medical staff and community service workers, reminding us that we all share the same compassion and gratitude.

The Washington State Chinese Chamber of Commerce (CCCWA) calls upon more restaurants, institutions, companies, and individuals to join this initiative and help provide assistance to more healthcare workers and community members in need. Our fundraising campaign is fully open and transparent, strictly complies with U.S. laws, and operates in accordance with the financial regulations for non-profit organizations. Both the amount of donations received and the food contributed will be announced in real time.

Let us all take action! It is not the size of the donation that matters, but the willingness to give. Let us demonstrate through our concrete actions the courage and responsibility of all communities standing together in the fight against the pandemic!

由华盛顿州中国总商会CCCWA发起倡议，豆捞坊中餐厅、IJ Sushi Burrito日餐厅、颐和园、蓉城老火锅、沸腾⻥乡、刘一手等领捐的“抗击疫 情爱心餐募捐活动” 得到了⻄雅图餐饮界的热烈响应，他们共同承诺提供总价值$242,250 美金，约14,150份营养套餐，以表达对奋战在抗疫前线的医护人员的感谢和敬意！ 

截至4月7日晚，参与爱心活动的几家餐厅在生意受到疫情打击下，依然慷慨尽力为社会做贡献。他们出资金、安排人力已制作完成2,535份爱心午餐(合计$4,5525美金）并送到医疗机构的医护人员、社区服务人员及需要救助的 社区成员手中。


“爱心午餐”活动开展得如火如荼并且有条不紊地进行着。活动也得到社会各界的热情支持，爱心捐款数目与日俱增。CCCWA已经收到了各界热心人士的现金捐赠美金$26,479，大家希望通过我们的平台捐赠更多的爱心餐。病毒当前，前线的医务人员选择日夜奋战，全力保护着我们的健康，我们也当进绵薄之力，为辛苦的医务人员捐上一份感激之心!

现在，UW Virology、Swedish Hospital、Overlake Hospital 、Evergreen Hospital 医院里奋战在抗疫一线的医护人员们已经享用到爱心午餐。很多医护人员收到爱心午餐后都感激不尽，通过自媒体发表了他们对CCCWA和赞助餐厅的感谢心声！ UW Virology的医护人员在Facebook上说：“这些爱心午餐简直太美味了“。


“爱心午餐”活动还将普及到更多医疗机构的医护人员、社区服务人员及需要救助的社区成员手里。新鲜烹制的爱心营养套餐将我们和医疗人员、社区服务人员拉近了距离，我们都有同样的爱心和感恩之情。

华盛顿州中国总商会倡议更多的餐饮企业加入进来，倡议更多的机构、公司和个人加入进来，为更多的医护人员和社区里需要救助的群体提供帮助。我们的募捐活动完全公开透明，严格遵守美国法律，且严格按照非营利机构的财务规定运作，捐款数目和捐助食品都将实时公布。


大家行动起来吧！爱心不在大小，数额不在多少，让我们以实际行动表达我们各族裔民众共抗疫情，共同担当的勇气和责任!

“爱心午餐”活动开展得如火如荼并且有条不紊地进行着。活动也得到社会各界的热情支持，爱心捐款数目与日俱增。CCCWA已经收到了各界热心人士的现金捐赠美金$26,479，大家希望通过我们的平台捐赠更多的爱心餐。病毒当前，前线的医务人员选择日夜奋战，全力保护着我们的健康，我们也当进绵薄之力，为辛苦的医务人员捐上一份感激之心!

content_blocks.en:
Healthcare workers on the front lines of the pandemic at UW Virology, Swedish Hospital, Overlake Hospital, and Evergreen Hospital have already enjoyed the love lunches. Many of them have been deeply grateful upon receiving the meals and have expressed their thanks to CCCWA and the sponsoring restaurants through social media. Healthcare workers at UW Virology posted on Facebook: "These love lunches are absolutely delicious!"

The "Love Lunch" initiative will also be extended to more healthcare workers at additional medical institutions, community service personnel, and community members in need. The freshly prepared, nutritious love meal packages bring us closer to the medical staff and community service workers, reminding us that we all share the same compassion and gratitude.
content_blocks.zh:
现在，UW Virology、Swedish Hospital、Overlake Hospital 、Evergreen Hospital 医院里奋战在抗疫一线的医护人员们已经享用到爱心午餐。很多医护人员收到爱心午餐后都感激不尽，通过自媒体发表了他们对CCCWA和赞助餐厅的感谢心声！ UW Virology的医护人员在Facebook上说：“这些爱心午餐简直太美味了“。


“爱心午餐”活动还将普及到更多医疗机构的医护人员、社区服务人员及需要救助的社区成员手里。新鲜烹制的爱心营养套餐将我们和医疗人员、社区服务人员拉近了距离，我们都有同样的爱心和感恩之情。

content_blocks.en:
The Washington State Chinese Chamber of Commerce (CCCWA) calls upon more restaurants, institutions, companies, and individuals to join this initiative and help provide assistance to more healthcare workers and community members in need. Our fundraising campaign is fully open and transparent, strictly complies with U.S. laws, and operates in accordance with the financial regulations for non-profit organizations. Both the amount of donations received and the food contributed will be announced in real time.

Let us all take action! It is not the size of the donation that matters, but the willingness to give. Let us demonstrate through our concrete actions the courage and responsibility of all communities standing together in the fight against the pandemic!
content_blocks.zh:
华盛顿州中国总商会倡议更多的餐饮企业加入进来，倡议更多的机构、公司和个人加入进来，为更多的医护人员和社区里需要救助的群体提供帮助。我们的募捐活动完全公开透明，严格遵守美国法律，且严格按照非营利机构的财务规定运作，捐款数目和捐助食品都将实时公布。


大家行动起来吧！爱心不在大小，数额不在多少，让我们以实际行动表达我们各族裔民众共抗疫情，共同担当的勇气和责任!
