items.title_en: You are cordially invited to hear the stories behind the love initiative — Join Us at the "Love Lunch" Press Conference.
items.title_zh: 邀请您聆听爱心活动背后的故事——“爱心午餐”新闻发布会诚邀您的参加
items.body_en:
At the beginning of April, a "CCCWA Love Lunch Fundraising Initiative" spread across the WeChat of the Chinese community in Seattle. People eagerly reposted it, not only praising the organizers for their kindness but also applauding this innovative way of showing support. The initiative was launched by the Washington State Chinese Chamber of Commerce (CCCWA), with participation from local Seattle restaurants and the delivery platform Chowbus as lead donors, and enthusiastic support from all sectors of the community. The project plans to raise USD 400,000 worth of love meals within one month, to be delivered to healthcare workers at medical institutions, community service personnel, and community members in need. As of April 11, six lead donor restaurants had pledged to donate a total of USD 242,000 worth of meal packages, and USD 27,000 in cash donations had been raised from the community.

After donating medical supplies such as masks and protective gowns to healthcare institutions, why did they choose to participate in the fight against the pandemic through the "Love Lunch" initiative? The organizer, CCCWA, hopes to leverage the association's own strengths and use its unique resources and methods to support healthcare workers. "Every member of the community is now contributing in their own way to serve the frontline healthcare workers and cheer on our city. As a non-profit organization voluntarily formed by Chinese-invested enterprises in Washington State, CCCWA has a group of outstanding and compassionate restaurant entrepreneurs. They learned that the pandemic has made the work schedules of healthcare workers even more intense and stressful, and ensuring that frontline medical staff can have a hot, delicious lunch on time became their wish. Although their businesses have been severely impacted by the pandemic, they still hope to give generously to support the frontline medical staff and make their own contribution to the city they love. So we connected restaurant resources and partnered with the delivery platform Chowbus to organize this Love Lunch initiative. We hope to unite forces from all sectors of society, raise more funds, and together amplify their kindness." This is how CCCWA President Lili Lv explained the motivation behind launching the event.


The "Love Lunch" initiative has received strong support from local restaurants and delivery platforms in the Seattle area. All participating restaurants are well-known establishments in the Seattle region, including: The Dolar Shop (in partnership with Asian Family Market), IJ Sushi Burrito, Liuyishou Hot Pot, Frying Fish (Futuro Fish), Imperial Garden (Yiyuan Peking Duck Restaurant), and Chengdu Memory (Rongcheng Old Hot Pot).

Despite the severe impact of the pandemic on the restaurant industry, which has brought business to a halt, the owners of these restaurants have not focused on their own profits. Instead, they have selflessly stepped forward to actively participate in preparing free meals, showing that they care not only about their own concerns but also about the greater good.

In terms of delivery, Chowbus, a professional delivery service platform, has taken the initiative to handle the distribution for this charitable event. Even though Chowbus is at its busiest during the pandemic, the company has still assigned dedicated staff to coordinate communication, scheduling, and delivery for this initiative, ensuring that love meals are delivered to healthcare workers on time every day.

In the two weeks since the launch of the event, numerous non-profit organizations have provided strong support and assistance, including the Seattle Entrepreneurship Club, Seattle Chinese New Immigrants Center, Seattle Real Estate Investment Club, Sunshine Youth Culture and Education Development Association, and Guangfu Association. In particular, Attorney Cai Qing from Cai & Cai Associates, Ms. Sylvia Chin, Li Ruoyao from Jing Wei LLC, Ms. Zhang Shuofu, and Rhea, a student at the University of Washington, not only took the lead in donating funds in the early stages of the project but also devoted significant time to making outstanding contributions to the project's progress. A total of over 30 volunteers form the working groups serving this event, hailing from various non-profit organizations, donor entities, communities, government agencies, universities, and high schools.

As of April 11, 3,845 love meals had been delivered, and 675 healthcare workers from 15 key hospitals fighting the pandemic—including UW Virology, Swedish Hospital, Overlake Hospital, and Evergreen Hospital—had already enjoyed these love lunches. The delivery scope will continue to expand, and the initiative will reach more healthcare workers at additional medical institutions, community service personnel, and community members in need.

Healthcare workers have expressed their heartfelt gratitude for this initiative. Many of them, upon receiving the love meals, were deeply appreciative and took to social media to share photos of their lunches, thanking the "Love Lunch" program in their own unique ways. They also tagged the participating restaurants, giving them "free advertising" as a way of saying thank you.

April is a season of beauty and warmth, yet all those involved in the "Love Lunch" initiative have had no time to enjoy the spring scenery. Instead, they have become busier each day, devoting their own efforts to fighting the pandemic. To provide a more comprehensive understanding of the "Love Lunch" project, and to hear the original aspirations of the participating restaurants and how the delivery platform Chowbus connects restaurants with hospitals in a timely manner, CCCWA will hold an online press conference on April 13 from 2:00 PM to 3:30 PM Seattle time. At that time, the heads of participating restaurants, representatives of co-organizing organizations, and working group members will share the stories behind this "Love Lunch" initiative. If you are a Chinese-language media outlet, self-media content creator, or a potential partner or individual interested in collaboration, we sincerely invite you to join this online sharing event.

Press Conference Time: April 13, 2:00 PM – 3:30 PM

Zoom Live Stream Link: https://washington.zoom.us/j/766492115

Press Conference Agenda:

  1. CCCWA President Lili Lv introduces the project overview

  2. Bellevue City Councilmember Conrad Lee delivers remarks

  3. Representatives from the three lead donor restaurants speak (The Dolar Shop, IJ Sushi, Yiyuan Seafood Restaurant)

  4. Attorney Cai Qing introduces the legal affairs of the project

  5. Sylvia, head of the liaison group, introduces the recipient hospitals

  6. Michelle, head of the delivery group, introduces the delivery operations

  7. Xiaoyan, head of the finance group, provides an update on donations and funds

  8. Grace, head of the publicity group, speaks; Rhea, head of English media relations, speaks

  9. Ji Yuan, head of the fundraising group, speaks

  10. Representatives of co-organizing organizations speak

  11. Q&A session

items.body_zh:
四月刚刚开始拉开序幕，一则“CCCWA抗击疫情爱心午餐募捐倡议书”传遍了西雅图华人的朋友圈，大家竞相转发，不但为活动主办方的爱心点赞，更是为这个独出心裁的献爱心方式叫好。该活动由华盛顿州中国总商会（简称：CCCWA）发起倡议、西雅图本地餐厅与外送平台Chowbus参与领捐，并由社会各界热情支持。活动计划在一个月内募集价值40万美元的爱心午餐送到医疗机构的医护人员、社区服务人员及需要救助的社区成员手中。截止4月11日，6家主捐餐厅承诺将共同捐赠总价值$24.2万美金的套餐，募集到社会各界捐款2.7万美元。

在向医疗机构捐赠口罩、防护服等医疗物资之后，为何又以“爱心午餐”形式参与到援助抗疫中？活动主办方CCCWA希望，发挥协会自身优势，用自己独特的方式和资源去支援医护人员。“现在社区的每一份子都用各自方式为抗疫前线的医护人员服务，为我们的城市加油。而CCCWA作为由华盛顿州中资企业自发组成的非营利性组织，拥有一批优秀而有爱的餐饮企业家，他们得知疫情让医护人员工作节奏更忙碌紧张，能让一线医护人员及时吃到可口的午餐成为他们的一个愿望，虽然疫情使他们的生意备受冲击，他们仍希望慷慨解囊，为一线医护人员助力，为自己热爱的城市做一点自己的贡献。于是我们对接餐厅资源，并联合外送平台Chowbus，一起组织了这次爱心午餐活动。我们希望联合社会各界力量，募集更多的资金，共同把他们的爱心放大。”CCCWA会长吕莉莉介绍本次活动发起缘由。

“爱心午餐”得到西雅图当地餐厅和外送平台的大力支持。参与活动的餐厅都是西雅图地区耳熟能详的知名餐厅：豆捞坊中餐厅（联手百家超市）、IJ Sushi Burrito日餐厅、刘一手火锅、沸腾鱼乡、颐和园北京烤鸭店、蓉城老火锅。由于受疫情影响，餐饮业暂停让餐饮业绩受到巨大冲击，但是这些餐馆负责人“不忧己而忧天下”，不但没把自身营利放在首位，反而无私奉献积极参与制作免费午餐。在配送上，拥有专业配送服务的Chowbus外卖平台主动承担起本次爱心活动的配送。尽管疫情期间正是Chowbus业务最为繁忙阶段，但是Chowbus依然配备了专门人员对接本次活动负责沟通排期与外送，每天准点将爱心午餐送到医护人员手中。

活动开展两周来，西创会、西雅图新移民之家、西雅图地产投资俱乐部、阳光青少年基金会、广府会等非营利组织均对活动给予大力支持与协助，尤其是蔡和蔡律师事务所的蔡清律师、Sylvia Chin女士、美国经纬有限公司李若垚、张硕夫妇女士、华大在校生Rhea，他们在项目前期不仅带头捐赠资金，还花费了大量时间为项目的推进做出杰出贡献，一共有三十几个志愿者组成的工作小组在为这个活动服务，他们来自各个非营利组织、捐赠单位、社区、政府、大学、高中……

截至4月11日，爱心午餐已送出3845份，UW Virology、SwedishHospital、Overlake Hospital、EvergreenHospital等15家重点抗疫医院的675位医护工作者们已经享用到了这些爱心午餐。送餐范围还将扩大，活动还将普及到更多医疗机构的医护人员、社区服务人员及需要救助的社区成员。医护工作者们对本次活动也表示了由衷感谢。很多医护人员收到爱心午餐后都感激不尽，纷纷在社交媒体上分享自己的爱心午餐，用自己独特的方式致谢“爱心午餐”，并纷纷@这些爱心餐厅给他们“打广告”。

人间芳菲四月天，这个本应是最美的季节，参与“爱心午餐”的所有人却无暇欣赏大美春光，他们每天更为忙碌，为抗击疫情而奉献一己之力。现在为了使大家更全面了解“爱心午餐”的规划，聆听这些餐饮企业参与本次活动的初心，以及外送平台Chowbus 如何做到及时连接餐厅与医院的，CCCWA将于4月13日西雅图时间2:00PM至3:30PM举行线上新闻发布会。届时，各餐厅负责人、协办机构负责人、工作组成员，将和大家分享这次“爱心午餐”背后的故事。如果您是西雅图的中文媒体、自媒体人以及有意向的合作单位或个人，诚邀您参加本次线上分享活动。
 
发布会时间：4月13日2：00PM-3：30PM
Zoom 网络直播链接: https://washington.zoom.us/j/766492115
 
发布会流程：
1． 主办单位CCCWA会长吕莉莉介绍活动概况
2． Bellevue市议员李瑞麟先生发言
3． 三位领捐餐厅代表发言（豆捞坊、IJ sushi 、颐和园）
4，蔡清律师介绍项目的法律事务
5， 联络组组长Sylvia介绍受捐医院情况
6， 配送组组长Michelle介绍配送情况
7， 财务组组长Xiaoyan介绍捐物资及资金情况
8， 文宣组组长Grace 发言、英文媒体负责人Rhea发言
9， 募捐组组长那济源发言
10，协办机构发言
11． 互动问答环节

content_blocks.zh: “爱心午餐”得到西雅图当地餐厅和外送平台的大力支持。参与活动的餐厅都是西雅图地区耳熟能详的知名餐厅：豆捞坊中餐厅（联手百家超市）、IJ Sushi Burrito日餐厅、刘一手火锅、沸腾鱼乡、颐和园北京烤鸭店、蓉城老火锅。由于受疫情影响，餐饮业暂停让餐饮业绩受到巨大冲击，但是这些餐馆负责人“不忧己而忧天下”，不但没把自身营利放在首位，反而无私奉献积极参与制作免费午餐。在配送上，拥有专业配送服务的Chowbus外卖平台主动承担起本次爱心活动的配送。尽管疫情期间正是Chowbus业务最为繁忙阶段，但是Chowbus依然配备了专门人员对接本次活动负责沟通排期与外送，每天准点将爱心午餐送到医护人员手中。

content_blocks.en: In the two weeks since the launch of the event, numerous non-profit organizations have provided strong support and assistance, including the Seattle Entrepreneurship Club, Seattle Chinese New Immigrants Center, Seattle Real Estate Investment Club, Sunshine Youth Culture and Education Development Association, and Guangfu Association. In particular, Attorney Cai Qing from Cai & Cai Associates, Ms. Sylvia Chin, Li Ruoyao from Jing Wei LLC, Ms. Zhang Shuofu, and Rhea, a student at the University of Washington, not only took the lead in donating funds in the early stages of the project but also devoted significant time to making outstanding contributions to the project's progress. A total of over 30 volunteers form the working groups serving this event, hailing from various non-profit organizations, donor entities, communities, government agencies, universities, and high schools.
content_blocks.zh: 活动开展两周来，西创会、西雅图新移民之家、西雅图地产投资俱乐部、阳光青少年基金会、广府会等非营利组织均对活动给予大力支持与协助，尤其是蔡和蔡律师事务所的蔡清律师、Sylvia Chin女士、美国经纬有限公司李若垚、张硕夫妇女士、华大在校生Rhea，他们在项目前期不仅带头捐赠资金，还花费了大量时间为项目的推进做出杰出贡献，一共有三十几个志愿者组成的工作小组在为这个活动服务，他们来自各个非营利组织、捐赠单位、社区、政府、大学、高中……

content_blocks.en:
As of April 11, 3,845 love meals had been delivered, and 675 healthcare workers from 15 key hospitals fighting the pandemic—including UW Virology, Swedish Hospital, Overlake Hospital, and Evergreen Hospital—had already enjoyed these love lunches. The delivery scope will continue to expand, and the initiative will reach more healthcare workers at additional medical institutions, community service personnel, and community members in need.

Healthcare workers have expressed their heartfelt gratitude for this initiative. Many of them, upon receiving the love meals, were deeply appreciative and took to social media to share photos of their lunches, thanking the "Love Lunch" program in their own unique ways. They also tagged the participating restaurants, giving them "free advertising" as a way of saying thank you.
content_blocks.zh: 截至4月11日，爱心午餐已送出3845份，UW Virology、SwedishHospital、Overlake Hospital、EvergreenHospital等15家重点抗疫医院的675位医护工作者们已经享用到了这些爱心午餐。送餐范围还将扩大，活动还将普及到更多医疗机构的医护人员、社区服务人员及需要救助的社区成员。医护工作者们对本次活动也表示了由衷感谢。很多医护人员收到爱心午餐后都感激不尽，纷纷在社交媒体上分享自己的爱心午餐，用自己独特的方式致谢“爱心午餐”，并纷纷@这些爱心餐厅给他们“打广告”。

content_blocks.en:
April is a season of beauty and warmth, yet all those involved in the "Love Lunch" initiative have had no time to enjoy the spring scenery. Instead, they have become busier each day, devoting their own efforts to fighting the pandemic. To provide a more comprehensive understanding of the "Love Lunch" project, and to hear the original aspirations of the participating restaurants and how the delivery platform Chowbus connects restaurants with hospitals in a timely manner, CCCWA will hold an online press conference on April 13 from 2:00 PM to 3:30 PM Seattle time. At that time, the heads of participating restaurants, representatives of co-organizing organizations, and working group members will share the stories behind this "Love Lunch" initiative. If you are a Chinese-language media outlet, self-media content creator, or a potential partner or individual interested in collaboration, we sincerely invite you to join this online sharing event.

items.title_en: The guest speaker for the fourth episode of CCCWA's (Washington State Chinese Chamber of Commerce) "Weekly Star" series will give a special presentation on "2019–2020 Tax Issues."
items.title_zh: 第四期CCCWA华盛顿州中国总商会 “每周一星“的做客嘉宾，为大家专题分享《2019-2020 税务问题》。
items.body_en:
Main Topics Include:

  • COVID-19 Relief and Economic Assistance Acts / Pandemic Unemployment Compensation

  • 2019 Tax Rates and Other Deduction Data / Home Office Deduction

  • Foreign Asset Reporting and Other Information Returns / Taxation of Bitcoin

  • Retirement Plan Enhancements

  • Depreciation Issues Related to Rental Real Estate

Our guest speaker, Annie Zheng, holds a Bachelor's and a Master's degree from Beijing Foreign Studies University, a Bachelor's degree in Accounting from the University of Washington, and a Master's degree in Taxation from Golden Gate University. She is a Certified Public Accountant in the State of Washington and a member of both the AICPA and WSCPA. Her professional expertise focuses on tax issues for new immigrants, including foreign asset reporting, corporate accounting, and investment income filing, as well as tax matters for foreigners investing in U.S. real estate, including ITIN (Individual Taxpayer Identification Number) applications. Annie is also an IRS-approved CAA (Certifying Acceptance Agent), authorized to certify passports for foreign individuals.

Our guest speaker, Mr. Steven Yun, holds a Bachelor's degree from the University of Hong Kong and a Master's degree in Accounting from the University of Washington. He is a Certified Public Accountant in the State of Washington and a member of both the AICPA and WSCPA. He has extensive experience in tax planning for corporations, including business start-ups, corporate structuring, and the selection of profit distribution methods. With long-term experience dealing with the IRS and state tax authorities, he is well-equipped to help clients mitigate risks during audits.

CCCWA has arranged lectures by these two tax experts in the hope of providing valuable assistance to everyone in their work and daily lives in the United States.

items.title_en: "Charity Lunch" Press Conference Successfully Held; Participants' Heartwarming Stories Move Seattle
items.title_zh: “爱心午餐”新闻发布会成功举行，参与者爱心故事感动西雅图
items.body_en:
At 2:00 PM on April 13, a special press conference was held in a Zoom live stream. The press conference for the "Love Lunch" donation event to support frontline healthcare workers attracted a number of prominent local social media outlets and viewers, who logged into the live stream early, eager to learn the stories behind the initiative. As the event began, the heads of the restaurants preparing the love meals, the delivery platform Chowbus, and various NPO organizations each shared why they had joined this effort. After hearing their stories, everyone couldn't help but marvel at how meaningful it was to do something so positive during such a difficult time. The speeches moved all the attendees—some offered to make donations on the spot, others expressed a desire to film a documentary about the event, and media friends said that although they could not directly participate, they would use their words to spread this love far and wide.

"We learned that during the pandemic, frontline healthcare workers are under tremendous pressure—some work 12-hour shifts, others work around-the-clock in three shifts. They often cannot eat in time, and sometimes don't even have time to order food. So we thought of using the Chamber of Commerce platform to bring together restaurants that wanted to donate love meals, and have them delivered in an organized manner to hospitals through the delivery platform Chowbus free of charge. That's how we launched this campaign with a fundraising goal of USD 400,000. Going forward, we hope to unite forces from all sectors of society to raise more funds. On top of the meals fully donated by restaurants, we plan to use the raised funds to cover some of the costs, produce more love meals, and multiply the impact of this kindness." This was how Lili Lv, President of the Washington State Chinese Chamber of Commerce and the initiator of this event, first introduced the project's origins.

"Love Lunch" Promotion

Regarding why the restaurants participated in the "Love Lunch" initiative, the first restaurants to launch this event—The Dolar Shop, IJ Sushi, and Yiyuan Seafood Restaurant—along with the delivery platform Chowbus, each shared their own moving stories behind the effort.

The Dolar Shop: From Community to Hospitals, Love Is Expanding

Bruce, the representative,介绍说 that The Dolar Shop was the first restaurant to start delivering love lunches. When they saw that many police officers, security guards, and drivers had no place to eat after the outbreak began, they started giving out free lunches at the restaurant's entrance so that those in need could get a meal at any time. Later, when they learned that healthcare workers were in even greater need of assistance, they expanded the scope of their love lunch program from the community to hospitals.

IJ Sushi: Even When Questioned, We Will Carry On

"When the pandemic broke out, we were all safely staying at home. But the frontline workers couldn't stay home—instead, they had to remain on standby at their posts for even longer hours, facing immense risks and pressure. I thought to myself: these healthcare workers are protecting us, so what can we do for them? At first, I put out a message through WeChat offering to send free meals to medical staff. To my surprise, the message was met with skepticism—many people didn't believe we would actually do it. But now, with the Love Lunch initiative in full swing, not only have we proven that we did it, but many like-minded restaurants have also joined us in this effort!" said Kevin, the owner of IJ Sushi.

Yiyuan Seafood Restaurant:

Restaurants May Close, But Love Never Stops

The representative of Yiyuan Seafood Restaurant said that the group to which the restaurant belongs has 48 other locations in China, all of which have been closed due to the impact of the pandemic. Not only has their revenue dropped sharply, but they also have to pay substantial rent and employee salaries. However, despite being severely affected themselves, when the group's owner learned that hospitals in Seattle needed assistance, he did not hesitate to support frontline medical staff with love lunches. To be able to give generously even in such difficult times is a testament to their sense of responsibility and commitment.

Chowbus: Through Wind and Rain, Mission Accomplished

As the enterprise responsible for the vital delivery of the love meals, Chowbus was one of the first companies to join this initiative. Michelle, the head of the delivery team and the representative of Chowbus, said at the press conference, "We were moved by the generous acts of the restaurants and wanted to use our own resources and strengths to help achieve this goal together with everyone."

It is understood that Chowbus faced considerable challenges in the meal delivery process. First, hospitals have strict requirements for meal delivery standards, including delivery time and food temperature—meals must be delivered within the specified time and at the proper temperature. Second, as the number of donating restaurants and healthcare workers receiving meals increased, the delivery tasks became even more demanding. Every day, Chowbus needs to pick up meals from different restaurants and deliver them to various hospitals, some of which are far beyond the normal delivery range. While Michelle was speaking, Chowbus drivers were already on the road, picking up meals from four restaurants and delivering them to eleven hospitals, with the farthest hospital located in Everett—a one-hour drive each way. Despite these challenges, Chowbus overcame every obstacle and fulfilled every mission.

To help raise funds for the "Love Lunch" initiative, Chowbus also set up a donation channel on its website and app, with the first batch of donations exceeding USD 3,000. In addition to these donations, Michelle led by example and personally donated USD 500, handing over both contributions to the finance team. To date, Chowbus has delivered over 2,000 love meal boxes and will continue to hit the road with love meals in the upcoming phases of the event.

In addition to the restaurants that attended the press conference, three other restaurants—Futuro Fish, Rongcheng Old Hot Pot, and Liu Yishou—also supported frontline medical staff with love lunches.

Futuro Fish: Doing Our Utmost to Contribute a Share of Love

Rongcheng Old Hot Pot: The Owner Personally Makes Cakes for Frontline Medical Staff

Liu Yishou: Boosting Healthcare Workers' Spirits with Exquisite Meals

Financial and Legal Support

This "Love Lunch" event also has strong legal and financial backing. At the press conference, the legal representative, Attorney Cai Qing, stated: "The greater the event, the greater the responsibility. We must not only carry out this charitable initiative well but also minimize potential risks. By inspecting the hygiene conditions of participating restaurants and drafting commitment letters, we have addressed potential risk points one by one, so that everyone can contribute with peace of mind."

The financial officer, Li Xiaoyan, also provided an update on the donations: "The fundraising target for this event is USD 400,000. To date, a total of 6 restaurants have donated 14,150 meal packages, amounting to USD 242,000. Of these, 4,145 meals worth USD 77,050 have already been delivered. Just during the press conference, Mr. Lai Huiwu, President of the 505 Group, upon learning of the event, donated an additional USD 2,000 to show his support."

Update: As of the publication date on the 16th, cash donations received have now reached USD 30,499.

The charity meals left the healthcare workers deeply grateful, and they often expressed their appreciation to the organizers in their own unique ways — some sent thank-you emails and text messages, while others shared photos of their charity lunches on social media. When they learned that this press conference was going to be held, they took time out of their busy schedules to create a special video message, in which they said: "Thank you. We are fighting the pandemic on the front lines, and you are watching over us from behind."

Charity Lunch – We Look Forward to Your Participation

This "Food With Love" charity campaign has acted like a powerful magnet, attracting more and more caring individuals to join in, and has also received support from fellow partner organizations. Rhea, a volunteer responsible for English-language publicity, was so moved upon learning about the campaign that she was nearly brought to tears, and she took the initiative to handle all updates for the campaign's Facebook, Twitter, and English website pages. Meanwhile, the Seattle Entrepreneurship Club, as a partner in this initiative, was deeply touched after reading the charity lunch proposal and gladly lent their support to the cause.

Throughout the one-hour press conference, the most frequently heard words were "love" and "dedication." While everyone has been troubled by the pandemic, this press conference felt more like a gathering of uplifting and heartwarming stories, warming the hearts of all who attended. Deeply moved by what we heard, we hope that even more people will step forward to join us. Together, let us do all we can to contribute to our community and the place we call home, and look forward to the day when Seattle will once again echo with laughter and joy!

Event Information

Organizer:

  • CCCWA – Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State

Supporting Organizations and Partners:

  • The Dolar Shop

  • Asian Family Market

4月13日下午2:00，一场特殊的新闻发布会在Zoom直播间里举行。这场向抗疫一线医护人员捐赠爱心午餐活动的新闻发布会吸引了不少当地知名社交媒体和观众，大家早早进入直播间里等待着，希望了解“爱心午餐”背后的故事。活动开始后，制作爱心午餐的餐厅负责人、负责配送的送餐平台Chowbus负责人、各个NPO组织负责人纷纷讲述自己参与到本次活动的缘由。当听完他们的讲述后，大家都不由感慨，能在这个特殊时期做这样一件有意义的事情太有正能量了！负责人们的发言感动了所有参会的人，有人当场表示捐赠，有人想要为这个活动拍摄纪录片，而媒体朋友表示虽然不能直接参与活动，但会用自己的文字去传递这份爱。


“在疫情中我们得知奋战在一线的医护人员工作强度特别大，有的是12小时一班，有的是24小时三班倒，他们不能及时用餐，甚至没有时间点餐，我们就想到用商会平台把想捐赠爱心午餐的餐厅聚集到一起，通过外送平台Chowbus免费配送有组织地送到医院，于是发起这个捐赠40万美金爱心餐的活动。后续希望联合社会各界力量，募集更多资金，在餐厅全额捐赠爱心餐的基础上，再用募集来的资金分担一些成本，多制作一些爱心餐把爱心放大。” 本次活动发起方、华盛顿州中国总商会会长吕莉莉首先介绍了这个项目发起的缘由。

“爱心午餐”宣传


关于餐厅为何参与到“爱心午餐”中，最先发起本次活动的餐厅豆捞坊、IJ Sushi、颐和园海鲜酒楼，以及送餐平台Chowbus分别分享了各自背后令人感动的故事。

豆捞坊：从社区到医院，爱心在扩大

负责人Bruce介绍，豆捞坊是最早一家开始送爱心午餐的餐厅，当看到疫情发生后很多警察、保安、司机没有吃饭的地方，他们便在饭店门口发放免费午餐，让这些需要帮助的人能随时获得。后来当得知医护人员更急需帮助后，他们的爱心午餐覆盖范围也从社区扩大到医院。

IJ Sushi：即使被质疑，也会做下去

“当疫情发生后，我们都安安全全待在家里，但一线人员不但不能待在家里，反而需要在工作岗位待命更长时间，他们需要顶着很大风险和压力去工作。我想，这些医护人员在守护我们，而我们又能为这些医护人员做些什么？一开始我先通过微信渠道发出想给医护人送免费餐的消息。没想到这个消息竟然收到质疑，很多人不相信我们会这么做。而现在爱心午餐活动的进行，不但证明我们做到了，而且还有很多志同道合的餐厅和我们一起在做！” IJ Sushi 老板Kevin说。


颐和园海鲜酒楼：

门店可以关  爱心不能断

颐和园海鲜酒楼负责人说，颐和园餐厅所在的集团在国内还有四十八家门店，因为受疫情影响都关闭了，不但营业额大幅下滑，还要支付不菲的房租和员工工资。然而在自身都受影响严重的情况下，当集团老板得知西雅图这边需要援助医院时候，还是义无反顾决定用爱心午餐支援医护人员。在艰难时刻还能慷慨解囊，是心中的一份责任与担当。

Chowubus:  风雨兼程 使命必达

作为担当爱心餐运输重任的Chowbus是最先参与到本次活动的企业之一，本次活动配送组组长、Chowbus负责人Michelle说，“能参加这个活动是被餐厅义举所感动，也想用自己资源和优势和大家一起实现这个目标。” 据了解Chowbus在送餐中确实遇到不少挑战：首先，医院对送餐标准有着严格的要求，比如送达时间、餐品温度等，要在规定时间将符合温度标准的食物送到。其次，随着捐助餐厅、受助医护人员的增多，让配送任务更为繁重。每天，Chowbus需要从不同餐厅出发送往不同医院，有的远远超出送餐范围。就在Michelle发言当时，Chowbus的司机正在赶在送餐的路上，要从4家餐厅取餐送到11个医院，而最远的一家医院在Everett，仅单程就需要1个小时车程。面对这些挑战，Chowbus都一一克服使命必达。为了给“爱心午餐”筹集捐款，Chowbus在网站和APP上也开通捐赠通道并将首批捐款3000多美元，除了这些捐款，Milchelle 自己也身体力行，率先捐款500美金，她已将这两笔捐款交给财务组。现在，Chowbus已经送出2000多份爱心盒饭，在接下来活动中还将继续带着爱心餐上路。


其实，除了参加新闻发布会的餐厅外，还有沸腾鱼乡、蓉城老火锅、刘一手这三家餐厅也都分别用爱心午餐来支援一线医务人员。


沸腾鱼乡：尽最大力  献一份爱

蓉城老火锅：老板娘亲手制蛋糕送一线医务人员

刘一手：用精美餐品给医护人员加油

财务和法律后盾


本次爱心午餐活动也有强大的律师和财务后盾。新闻发布会上，法律负责人蔡青律师说：“活动越大责任就越大，既要把爱心活动做好，又要把潜在风险降低。通过对加盟餐馆的卫生条件进行考察，并起草承诺函等，将潜在风险点一一排除，让大家更能踏踏实实献爱心。”财务负责人李晓艳也介绍了活动的捐赠情况：“本次活动目标筹款40万美金，截止目前为止，6家餐厅总捐赠14150份套餐的金额是24.2万美金，已经捐出的4145份餐食价值77050美金，就在新闻发布会进行中，得知消息的505集团总裁来辉武先生也捐款2000美金表示对活动的支持。”


更新：在16日发稿当日，目前已经收到现金捐赠30499美元。” 


来自医护人员的感谢

爱心午餐让受捐助的医护人员感激不尽，他们经常用自己不同的方式来表达对活动组织方的感激，有的发Email和短信来致谢，有的在社交媒体上分享自己的爱心午餐。当医护人员得知要召开这次新闻发布会时，他们特意在百忙之中制作了小视频说：“感谢你们，我们在前线抗疫，你们在背后守护我们。”

爱心午餐 期待你的加入


这场“爱心午餐”活动就像一块磁力极强的磁铁，吸引了越来越多有爱心的人加入，也得到兄弟协会的支援。负责英文文宣的志愿者Rhea了解了这个爱心故事后差点落泪并主动承担起本次活动Facebook、Twitter 、英文网页等所有更新工作。而西雅图创业协会作为本次活动的合作伙伴在看到爱心午餐倡议书被感动，也发挥一臂之力帮助本次活动。


短短一个多小时的发布会，听到最多的就是爱和奉献，当大家都在被疫情而困扰时，这个新闻发布会就像是一个正能量的故事分享会，让所有人都感到温暖。在为之动容之际，也希望能有更多人参与进来，齐心协力，尽我们所能，为社区和我们生活的地方贡献一份力量，期待西雅图早日恢复往昔的欢声笑语！

content_blocks.en:
At 2:00 PM on April 13, a special press conference was held in a Zoom live stream. The press conference for the "Love Lunch" donation event to support frontline healthcare workers attracted a number of prominent local social media outlets and viewers, who logged into the live stream early, eager to learn the stories behind the initiative. As the event began, the heads of the restaurants preparing the love meals, the delivery platform Chowbus, and various NPO organizations each shared why they had joined this effort. After hearing their stories, everyone couldn't help but marvel at how meaningful it was to do something so positive during such a difficult time. The speeches moved all the attendees—some offered to make donations on the spot, others expressed a desire to film a documentary about the event, and media friends said that although they could not directly participate, they would use their words to spread this love far and wide.

"We learned that during the pandemic, frontline healthcare workers are under tremendous pressure—some work 12-hour shifts, others work around-the-clock in three shifts. They often cannot eat in time, and sometimes don't even have time to order food. So we thought of using the Chamber of Commerce platform to bring together restaurants that wanted to donate love meals, and have them delivered in an organized manner to hospitals through the delivery platform Chowbus free of charge. That's how we launched this campaign with a fundraising goal of USD 400,000. Going forward, we hope to unite forces from all sectors of society to raise more funds. On top of the meals fully donated by restaurants, we plan to use the raised funds to cover some of the costs, produce more love meals, and multiply the impact of this kindness." This was how Lili Lv, President of the Washington State Chinese Chamber of Commerce and the initiator of this event, first introduced the project's origins.

"Love Lunch" Promotion

Regarding why the restaurants participated in the "Love Lunch" initiative, the first restaurants to launch this event—The Dolar Shop, IJ Sushi, and Yiyuan Seafood Restaurant—along with the delivery platform Chowbus, each shared their own moving stories behind the effort.

The Dolar Shop: From Community to Hospitals, Love Is Expanding
content_blocks.zh:
“爱心午餐”宣传


关于餐厅为何参与到“爱心午餐”中，最先发起本次活动的餐厅豆捞坊、IJ Sushi、颐和园海鲜酒楼，以及送餐平台Chowbus分别分享了各自背后令人感动的故事。

豆捞坊：从社区到医院，爱心在扩大

content_blocks.en:
Bruce, the representative,介绍说 that The Dolar Shop was the first restaurant to start delivering love lunches. When they saw that many police officers, security guards, and drivers had no place to eat after the outbreak began, they started giving out free lunches at the restaurant's entrance so that those in need could get a meal at any time. Later, when they learned that healthcare workers were in even greater need of assistance, they expanded the scope of their love lunch program from the community to hospitals.

IJ Sushi: Even When Questioned, We Will Carry On
content_blocks.zh:
负责人Bruce介绍，豆捞坊是最早一家开始送爱心午餐的餐厅，当看到疫情发生后很多警察、保安、司机没有吃饭的地方，他们便在饭店门口发放免费午餐，让这些需要帮助的人能随时获得。后来当得知医护人员更急需帮助后，他们的爱心午餐覆盖范围也从社区扩大到医院。

IJ Sushi：即使被质疑，也会做下去

content_blocks.en:
"When the pandemic broke out, we were all safely staying at home. But the frontline workers couldn't stay home—instead, they had to remain on standby at their posts for even longer hours, facing immense risks and pressure. I thought to myself: these healthcare workers are protecting us, so what can we do for them? At first, I put out a message through WeChat offering to send free meals to medical staff. To my surprise, the message was met with skepticism—many people didn't believe we would actually do it. But now, with the Love Lunch initiative in full swing, not only have we proven that we did it, but many like-minded restaurants have also joined us in this effort!" said Kevin, the owner of IJ Sushi.

Yiyuan Seafood Restaurant:

Restaurants May Close, But Love Never Stops
content_blocks.zh:
“当疫情发生后，我们都安安全全待在家里，但一线人员不但不能待在家里，反而需要在工作岗位待命更长时间，他们需要顶着很大风险和压力去工作。我想，这些医护人员在守护我们，而我们又能为这些医护人员做些什么？一开始我先通过微信渠道发出想给医护人送免费餐的消息。没想到这个消息竟然收到质疑，很多人不相信我们会这么做。而现在爱心午餐活动的进行，不但证明我们做到了，而且还有很多志同道合的餐厅和我们一起在做！” IJ Sushi 老板Kevin说。


颐和园海鲜酒楼：

门店可以关  爱心不能断

content_blocks.en:
The representative of Yiyuan Seafood Restaurant said that the group to which the restaurant belongs has 48 other locations in China, all of which have been closed due to the impact of the pandemic. Not only has their revenue dropped sharply, but they also have to pay substantial rent and employee salaries. However, despite being severely affected themselves, when the group's owner learned that hospitals in Seattle needed assistance, he did not hesitate to support frontline medical staff with love lunches. To be able to give generously even in such difficult times is a testament to their sense of responsibility and commitment.

Chowbus: Through Wind and Rain, Mission Accomplished
content_blocks.zh:
颐和园海鲜酒楼负责人说，颐和园餐厅所在的集团在国内还有四十八家门店，因为受疫情影响都关闭了，不但营业额大幅下滑，还要支付不菲的房租和员工工资。然而在自身都受影响严重的情况下，当集团老板得知西雅图这边需要援助医院时候，还是义无反顾决定用爱心午餐支援医护人员。在艰难时刻还能慷慨解囊，是心中的一份责任与担当。

Chowubus:  风雨兼程 使命必达

content_blocks.en:
As the enterprise responsible for the vital delivery of the love meals, Chowbus was one of the first companies to join this initiative. Michelle, the head of the delivery team and the representative of Chowbus, said at the press conference, "We were moved by the generous acts of the restaurants and wanted to use our own resources and strengths to help achieve this goal together with everyone."

It is understood that Chowbus faced considerable challenges in the meal delivery process. First, hospitals have strict requirements for meal delivery standards, including delivery time and food temperature—meals must be delivered within the specified time and at the proper temperature. Second, as the number of donating restaurants and healthcare workers receiving meals increased, the delivery tasks became even more demanding. Every day, Chowbus needs to pick up meals from different restaurants and deliver them to various hospitals, some of which are far beyond the normal delivery range. While Michelle was speaking, Chowbus drivers were already on the road, picking up meals from four restaurants and delivering them to eleven hospitals, with the farthest hospital located in Everett—a one-hour drive each way. Despite these challenges, Chowbus overcame every obstacle and fulfilled every mission.

To help raise funds for the "Love Lunch" initiative, Chowbus also set up a donation channel on its website and app, with the first batch of donations exceeding USD 3,000. In addition to these donations, Michelle led by example and personally donated USD 500, handing over both contributions to the finance team. To date, Chowbus has delivered over 2,000 love meal boxes and will continue to hit the road with love meals in the upcoming phases of the event.

In addition to the restaurants that attended the press conference, three other restaurants—Futuro Fish, Rongcheng Old Hot Pot, and Liu Yishou—also supported frontline medical staff with love lunches.

Futuro Fish: Doing Our Utmost to Contribute a Share of Love
content_blocks.zh:
作为担当爱心餐运输重任的Chowbus是最先参与到本次活动的企业之一，本次活动配送组组长、Chowbus负责人Michelle说，“能参加这个活动是被餐厅义举所感动，也想用自己资源和优势和大家一起实现这个目标。” 据了解Chowbus在送餐中确实遇到不少挑战：首先，医院对送餐标准有着严格的要求，比如送达时间、餐品温度等，要在规定时间将符合温度标准的食物送到。其次，随着捐助餐厅、受助医护人员的增多，让配送任务更为繁重。每天，Chowbus需要从不同餐厅出发送往不同医院，有的远远超出送餐范围。就在Michelle发言当时，Chowbus的司机正在赶在送餐的路上，要从4家餐厅取餐送到11个医院，而最远的一家医院在Everett，仅单程就需要1个小时车程。面对这些挑战，Chowbus都一一克服使命必达。为了给“爱心午餐”筹集捐款，Chowbus在网站和APP上也开通捐赠通道并将首批捐款3000多美元，除了这些捐款，Milchelle 自己也身体力行，率先捐款500美金，她已将这两笔捐款交给财务组。现在，Chowbus已经送出2000多份爱心盒饭，在接下来活动中还将继续带着爱心餐上路。


其实，除了参加新闻发布会的餐厅外，还有沸腾鱼乡、蓉城老火锅、刘一手这三家餐厅也都分别用爱心午餐来支援一线医务人员。


沸腾鱼乡：尽最大力  献一份爱

content_blocks.en: Rongcheng Old Hot Pot: The Owner Personally Makes Cakes for Frontline Medical Staff
content_blocks.zh: 蓉城老火锅：老板娘亲手制蛋糕送一线医务人员

content_blocks.en: Liu Yishou: Boosting Healthcare Workers' Spirits with Exquisite Meals
content_blocks.zh: 刘一手：用精美餐品给医护人员加油

content_blocks.en:
Financial and Legal Support

This "Love Lunch" event also has strong legal and financial backing. At the press conference, the legal representative, Attorney Cai Qing, stated: "The greater the event, the greater the responsibility. We must not only carry out this charitable initiative well but also minimize potential risks. By inspecting the hygiene conditions of participating restaurants and drafting commitment letters, we have addressed potential risk points one by one, so that everyone can contribute with peace of mind."

The financial officer, Li Xiaoyan, also provided an update on the donations: "The fundraising target for this event is USD 400,000. To date, a total of 6 restaurants have donated 14,150 meal packages, amounting to USD 242,000. Of these, 4,145 meals worth USD 77,050 have already been delivered. Just during the press conference, Mr. Lai Huiwu, President of the 505 Group, upon learning of the event, donated an additional USD 2,000 to show his support."

Update: As of the publication date on the 16th, cash donations received have now reached USD 30,499.
content_blocks.zh:
财务和法律后盾


本次爱心午餐活动也有强大的律师和财务后盾。新闻发布会上，法律负责人蔡青律师说：“活动越大责任就越大，既要把爱心活动做好，又要把潜在风险降低。通过对加盟餐馆的卫生条件进行考察，并起草承诺函等，将潜在风险点一一排除，让大家更能踏踏实实献爱心。”财务负责人李晓艳也介绍了活动的捐赠情况：“本次活动目标筹款40万美金，截止目前为止，6家餐厅总捐赠14150份套餐的金额是24.2万美金，已经捐出的4145份餐食价值77050美金，就在新闻发布会进行中，得知消息的505集团总裁来辉武先生也捐款2000美金表示对活动的支持。”


更新：在16日发稿当日，目前已经收到现金捐赠30499美元。” 


来自医护人员的感谢

content_blocks.caption_en: Healthcare Workers Express Gratitude for the "Charity Lunch" Campaign
content_blocks.caption_zh: 医护人员感谢“爱心午餐”

content_blocks.en: The charity meals left the healthcare workers deeply grateful, and they often expressed their appreciation to the organizers in their own unique ways — some sent thank-you emails and text messages, while others shared photos of their charity lunches on social media. When they learned that this press conference was going to be held, they took time out of their busy schedules to create a special video message, in which they said: "Thank you. We are fighting the pandemic on the front lines, and you are watching over us from behind."
content_blocks.zh: 爱心午餐让受捐助的医护人员感激不尽，他们经常用自己不同的方式来表达对活动组织方的感激，有的发Email和短信来致谢，有的在社交媒体上分享自己的爱心午餐。当医护人员得知要召开这次新闻发布会时，他们特意在百忙之中制作了小视频说：“感谢你们，我们在前线抗疫，你们在背后守护我们。”

content_blocks.caption_en: Hospitals That Received the "Charity Lunch" Donations
content_blocks.caption_zh: “爱心午餐”受捐医院

content_blocks.en:
Charity Lunch – We Look Forward to Your Participation

This "Food With Love" charity campaign has acted like a powerful magnet, attracting more and more caring individuals to join in, and has also received support from fellow partner organizations. Rhea, a volunteer responsible for English-language publicity, was so moved upon learning about the campaign that she was nearly brought to tears, and she took the initiative to handle all updates for the campaign's Facebook, Twitter, and English website pages. Meanwhile, the Seattle Entrepreneurship Club, as a partner in this initiative, was deeply touched after reading the charity lunch proposal and gladly lent their support to the cause.

Throughout the one-hour press conference, the most frequently heard words were "love" and "dedication." While everyone has been troubled by the pandemic, this press conference felt more like a gathering of uplifting and heartwarming stories, warming the hearts of all who attended. Deeply moved by what we heard, we hope that even more people will step forward to join us. Together, let us do all we can to contribute to our community and the place we call home, and look forward to the day when Seattle will once again echo with laughter and joy!
content_blocks.zh:
爱心午餐 期待你的加入


这场“爱心午餐”活动就像一块磁力极强的磁铁，吸引了越来越多有爱心的人加入，也得到兄弟协会的支援。负责英文文宣的志愿者Rhea了解了这个爱心故事后差点落泪并主动承担起本次活动Facebook、Twitter 、英文网页等所有更新工作。而西雅图创业协会作为本次活动的合作伙伴在看到爱心午餐倡议书被感动，也发挥一臂之力帮助本次活动。


短短一个多小时的发布会，听到最多的就是爱和奉献，当大家都在被疫情而困扰时，这个新闻发布会就像是一个正能量的故事分享会，让所有人都感到温暖。在为之动容之际，也希望能有更多人参与进来，齐心协力，尽我们所能，为社区和我们生活的地方贡献一份力量，期待西雅图早日恢复往昔的欢声笑语！

items.title_en: "Weekly Star" Episode 5 – Guest Zhang Ming (MZA Architecture) Shares Insights on "U.S. Real Estate Development, Investment, and Design Process"
items.title_zh: 第五期CCCWA“每周一星”做客嘉宾张铭 （MZA建筑设计事务所）分享《美国房地产开发投资和设计流程》
items.body_en:
Key topics include:

  • Key points to keep in mind when investing in Seattle and Bellevue real estate

  • The main process of real estate development and design in Seattle and Bellevue, and the differences in design requirements between the two cities

  • Government requirements for land use approval

  • Approval steps during the design process

  • Codes and standards that require special attention during the design process

Guest Speaker Introduction: Mr. Zhang Ming is the founder of MZA Architecture, an internationally renowned architect who has received numerous awards. He specializes particularly in large-scale urban complexes and high-rise building design. His works are located throughout the United States, Asia, and the Middle East. He is also a highly sought-after speaker, especially in the fields of high-rise buildings, culture and architecture, and green architecture. He has published articles and delivered speeches at the Council on Tall Buildings and Urban Habitat, the American Institute of Architects, the Architectural Society of China, and over 30 international academic conferences. He is a registered architect in the United States and a Fellow of the American Institute of Architects (FAIA).

MZA Architecture is an internationally acclaimed architectural design firm headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, with an office in Shanghai. The firm provides creative architectural, interior, and planning design services to local clients as well as developers and investors from China. The project portfolio ranges from custom private villas to mid-rise and high-rise apartments, hotels, and commercial centers. Currently in design in the Greater Seattle area are two high-rise apartment buildings, a high-rise hotel, and numerous mid-rise apartment projects. In China, the firm is involved in projects of even greater scale, with the tallest building reaching 500 meters in height.

MZA建筑设计有限公司是一家国际知名建筑设计公司。总部位于美国贝尔维市，并在上海设有办公室。本司为本地以及来自中国的开发商和投资人提供富有创意的建筑，室内和规划设计服务。项目种类从私人定制别墅，到多层及高层公寓，酒店，及商业中心等。目前正在设计中的大西雅图地区项目包括二栋高层公寓，一栋高层酒店，以及众多多层公寓项目。中国的项目更是规模巨大，最高建筑达500米之高。

items.id: chowbus-每天穿梭在餐厅和医院-警察局之间的爱的使者
items.title_en: Chowbus: Messengers of Love, Shuttling Between Restaurants, Hospitals, and Police Stations Every Day
items.title_zh: Chowbus: 每天穿梭在餐厅和医院、警察局之间的爱的使者
items.body_en:
When the love lunch campaign was first launched, Chowbus joined immediately. Michelle, the head of Chowbus, also served as the team leader for the meal delivery group. Michelle said: "I joined this activity because I was deeply moved by the restaurants' generous and selfless act, and I wanted to use my resources and expertise to help achieve this goal together with everyone. While almost everyone else was staying safe at home, medical workers, police officers, and other essential personnel remained on duty. I hope we can show our care and appreciation to those working on the front lines, so that they can feel some warmth and support while protecting us."

When the "Love Lunch" activity was first launched, Chowbus joined immediately, and Michelle, the head of Chowbus, also served as the leader of the delivery team for this initiative. Michelle said, "I was completely moved by the restaurant owners' acts of kindness in participating in this activity, and I wanted to use our resources and strengths to work together with everyone to achieve this goal. At a time when almost everyone is staying safe at home, medical workers, police officers, and others still need to remain at their posts. We hope to show some care to those on the front lines, so that they can feel some warmth and companionship while they protect us."

Connecting restaurants and frontline workers through delivery services

For the Love Lunch initiative, the Chowbus staff put in tremendous effort, and the company itself set aside its own profits to contribute to this public welfare cause. It is understood that the outbreak caused Chowbus's business to grow rapidly in a short period of time. While ensuring high-quality service for its own users, Chowbus not only hired more drivers but also dispatched office staff to assist with the Love Lunch activities at any time, ensuring that tasks were completed on time and to a high standard.

Every day, Chowbus delivers hundreds of love lunch meals. These meals require Chowbus staff to first pick up food from various restaurants and then deliver them to different hospitals, police stations, and mobile testing sites. The recipient organizations are widely dispersed; for some distant hospitals, a round trip can exceed a hundred miles, and a single delivery task—from pickup to completion—can take at least three hours. Despite this, the Chowbus delivery staff never complain. No matter how many meals or how far the distance, they gladly accept every task. When some hospitals impose strict requirements on delivery times and food temperatures, they ensure the meals arrive within the specified time and at the proper temperature. When the participating restaurants need help, Chowbus employees put on protective gear, assist with packing and loading, and head to their destinations with steaming meal boxes. Michelle also expressed her gratitude to the restaurants that have been working side by side with them, including Dolar Shop, IJ Sushi, Yi He Yuan Seafood Restaurant, Rong Cheng Hot Pot, Boiling Fish, and Liuyishou. She said that it is precisely because of everyone's seamless coordination that the love meals can be delivered in a timely manner.

Connecting users and love lunches through the platform

On one hand, Chowbus uses its delivery service to connect restaurants and frontline workers; on the other hand, Chowbus leverages its online platform to connect the general public with the love lunch initiative.

When many people saw reports about the "Love Lunch" activity, they expressed a desire to donate love meals themselves. In response, Chowbus set up a donation channel on its website and app, allowing users to choose to donate a love lunch to police and frontline command hotlines, to ICU and ER medical staff, to mobile testing stations, or to make other monetary donations. On the very first day the donation feature went live, it received widespread recognition from users, who generously contributed. One anonymous user even donated dozens of love meals in one go. The platform also received over $3,000 in爱心 donations from users, and Michelle herself took the lead by donating $500. All these donations were transferred to the activity's finance team to purchase more love meals for frontline workers.

Whenever medical workers and police officers received the love meals from Chowbus drivers, their faces were filled with bright, happy smiles. They said that receiving these "love lunches" warmed their hearts and gave them even greater motivation in their fight against the pandemic. Just last week, when the officers at the Bellevue Police Department enjoyed the love lunch for the first time, they happily posted on Facebook to thank Chowbus and the restaurants!

在爱心午餐活动刚刚发起时，Chowbus就第一时间加入进来，Chowbus 负责人Michelle也担任了本次爱心午餐配送组组长的工作。Michelle说：“能参加这个活动完全是被餐厅义举所感动，也想用自己资源和优势和大家一起实现这个目标。在几乎所有的人都安全在家时，此时医务工作者、警察这些人却需要坚守岗位，希望能给奋战在一线岗位的工作者一些关怀，让他们能在守护我们的同时感到一些温暖和陪伴。”

在爱心午餐活动刚刚发起时，Chowbus就第一时间加入进来，Chowbus 负责人Michelle也担任了本次爱心午餐配送组组长的工作。Michelle说：“能参加这个活动完全是被餐厅义举所感动，也想用自己资源和优势和大家一起实现这个目标。在几乎所有的人都安全在家时，此时医务工作者、警察这些人却需要坚守岗位，希望能给奋战在一线岗位的工作者一些关怀，让他们能在守护我们的同时感到一些温暖和陪伴。”


用配送服务连接餐厅和一线工作者


为了爱心午餐，Chowbus工作人员付出了辛勤汗水，而Chowbus公司更是舍弃自己盈利去做公益。据了解，疫情的发生让Chowbus自身业务短期内迅速增长。在保证提供给自己用户高质量服务的前提下，Chowbus不但增加雇佣司机、更是出动办公室工作人员，随时援助爱心午餐活动，保质保量完成任务。

每天，Chowbus都要完成几百份爱心午餐的配送任务。这数百份的爱心餐都需要Chowbus工作人员先分别去各个餐厅取餐，然后送往不同的医院、警察局、移动检测点。受捐机构都分布很分散，远些的医院去一趟往返路程加起来得一百多英里，一单任务从取餐到送餐完成的时间加起来至少花费三个小时。但是，Chowbu配送人员毫无怨言，再多的餐、再远的路他们都欣然接受。当有的医院对送餐时间、餐品温度有着严格的要求时，他们也能在规定时间将符合温度标准的食物送到。当爱心午餐餐厅需要帮忙时，Chowbus的员工就会带上防护品，帮助餐厅打包、装车，带着热气腾腾的饭盒前往目的地。在此，Michelle 也向共同奋战的豆捞坊、IJ Sushi、颐和园海鲜酒楼、蓉城老火锅、沸腾鱼乡、刘一手等餐厅表示感谢，她说，正是因为大家的默契配合，才能让爱心餐及时送达。 


用平台连接用户和爱心午餐


一方面，Chowbus用配送服务连接餐厅和一线工作者 ；另一方面，Chowbus用自己的网络平台连接大众用户和爱心午餐。


当很多人看到“爱心午餐”的活动报道后，都纷纷表示自己也想捐助爱心午餐。为此，Chowbus在网站和APP上也开通捐赠通道，用户可以选择捐一顿爱心餐给警察以及前线指挥热线、给ICU、ER的一线医护人员、捐给移动监测站、以及其他金额捐赠。捐赠爱心餐功能上线当天就收到用户们认可并纷纷解囊，甚至有位匿名用户一口气捐了几十份爱心午餐。平台上还收到用户们的3000多美金爱心捐款，Michelle本人也带头捐赠500美金，这些捐款都一并转给活动财务组，用来给一线工作人员们购买更多爱心餐。

每当医护人员、警察从Chowbus司机手中接过爱心餐时，脸上都洋溢着灿烂幸福的笑容，他们说，能收到这些“爱心午餐”内心很温暖，这给他们抗疫工作增添了更大的动力。就在上周，当Bellevue 警察局的警察们首次享用到爱心午餐时，开心地在Facebook发文感谢Chowbus、感谢餐厅！

When the "Love Lunch" activity was first launched, Chowbus joined immediately, and Michelle, the head of Chowbus, also served as the leader of the delivery team for this initiative. Michelle said, "I was completely moved by the restaurant owners' acts of kindness in participating in this activity, and I wanted to use our resources and strengths to work together with everyone to achieve this goal. At a time when almost everyone is staying safe at home, medical workers, police officers, and others still need to remain at their posts. We hope to show some care to those on the front lines, so that they can feel some warmth and companionship while they protect us."

Connecting restaurants and frontline workers through delivery services

For the Love Lunch initiative, the Chowbus staff put in tremendous effort, and the company itself set aside its own profits to contribute to this public welfare cause. It is understood that the outbreak caused Chowbus's business to grow rapidly in a short period of time. While ensuring high-quality service for its own users, Chowbus not only hired more drivers but also dispatched office staff to assist with the Love Lunch activities at any time, ensuring that tasks were completed on time and to a high standard.

用配送服务连接餐厅和一线工作者


为了爱心午餐，Chowbus工作人员付出了辛勤汗水，而Chowbus公司更是舍弃自己盈利去做公益。据了解，疫情的发生让Chowbus自身业务短期内迅速增长。在保证提供给自己用户高质量服务的前提下，Chowbus不但增加雇佣司机、更是出动办公室工作人员，随时援助爱心午餐活动，保质保量完成任务。

content_blocks.en:
Every day, Chowbus delivers hundreds of love lunch meals. These meals require Chowbus staff to first pick up food from various restaurants and then deliver them to different hospitals, police stations, and mobile testing sites. The recipient organizations are widely dispersed; for some distant hospitals, a round trip can exceed a hundred miles, and a single delivery task—from pickup to completion—can take at least three hours. Despite this, the Chowbus delivery staff never complain. No matter how many meals or how far the distance, they gladly accept every task. When some hospitals impose strict requirements on delivery times and food temperatures, they ensure the meals arrive within the specified time and at the proper temperature. When the participating restaurants need help, Chowbus employees put on protective gear, assist with packing and loading, and head to their destinations with steaming meal boxes. Michelle also expressed her gratitude to the restaurants that have been working side by side with them, including Dolar Shop, IJ Sushi, Yi He Yuan Seafood Restaurant, Rong Cheng Hot Pot, Boiling Fish, and Liuyishou. She said that it is precisely because of everyone's seamless coordination that the love meals can be delivered in a timely manner.

Connecting users and love lunches through the platform

On one hand, Chowbus uses its delivery service to connect restaurants and frontline workers; on the other hand, Chowbus leverages its online platform to connect the general public with the love lunch initiative.

When many people saw reports about the "Love Lunch" activity, they expressed a desire to donate love meals themselves. In response, Chowbus set up a donation channel on its website and app, allowing users to choose to donate a love lunch to police and frontline command hotlines, to ICU and ER medical staff, to mobile testing stations, or to make other monetary donations. On the very first day the donation feature went live, it received widespread recognition from users, who generously contributed. One anonymous user even donated dozens of love meals in one go. The platform also received over $3,000 in爱心 donations from users, and Michelle herself took the lead by donating $500. All these donations were transferred to the activity's finance team to purchase more love meals for frontline workers.

items.title_en: Kiro7 News Series Coverage – CCCWA's "Food with Love" and Other Public Welfare Initiatives in the Fight Against COVID-19
items.title_zh: Kiro7 News 系列报道CCCWA“Food with Love"等 抗击疫情公益活动
items.body_en:
In response to the sudden outbreak of the novel coronavirus (COVID-19) pandemic, member organizations of the CCCWA (Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State) demonstrated their corporate social responsibility across various sectors. They actively coordinated with their domestic and international branches to procure essential supplies and donated them free of charge to institutions in hard-hit areas in urgent need. After donating medical supplies such as masks and protective gowns to healthcare facilities, the CCCWA further organized a group of outstanding and compassionate local restaurants to donate love lunches valued at $400,000 to medical staff on the front lines.

Seattle's local television station Kiro7 News conducted a special interview with one of the participating restaurants, The Dolar Shop, as well as CCCWA President Ms. Lili Lyu and member attorney Cai Qing, and produced a featured report on the initiative.

Kiro7 News Report 1 – CCCWA's "Food with Love" and other public welfare campaigns organized during the fight against the COVID-19 pandemic.

阿打发发的是

Kiro7 News Report 2 – Reporter Deedee Sun tells the story of how The Dolar Shop and other restaurants, despite facing their own survival difficulties amid the pandemic's impact, remained deeply concerned about the safety of the community and the front lines of the fight against COVID-19.

Kiro7 News Report 3 – The "Food with Love" charity event delivered hundreds of love meals today, and frontline medical workers were deeply moved.

Kiro7 News Report 4 – The "Food with Love" charity event is about to reach its goal of delivering 400,000 love meals to frontline pandemic fighters.

Kiro7 News Report 5 – The "Food with Love" campaign is raising funds to help cover the production costs of participating restaurants, so that the whole community can come together to amplify this act of kindness.

Kiro7 News Report 1 – CCCWA's "Food with Love" and other public welfare campaigns organized during the fight against the COVID-19 pandemic.

items.title_en: "Weekly Star" Episode 11 – Jason Moore from Local Real Estate Firm Windermere Shares New Insights on Residential Real Estate Investment in the Greater Seattle Area
items.title_zh: 第11期“每周一星”--来自本地房地产Windermere 的Jason Moore分享大西雅图地区住宅地产投资的新信息
items.body_en:
This week's guest speaker is Jason Moore, founder of the Seattle-based real estate firm Windermere Real Estate/PSR Inc., who, together with his colleague Laura Yang, hosted a session sharing the latest insights on residential real estate investment in the Greater Seattle area.

In residential market transactions—whether for purchases or sales—Windermere accounts for nearly one-quarter of the total transaction volume in the local market.

Jason noted that when the local residential market's inventory exceeds three months, it can be considered a buyer's market. The most recent buyer's market occurred in 2011. Since the last real estate rebound, the residential market in the Greater Seattle area has remained a seller's market due to a shortage of housing inventory.

Due to the impact of the pandemic and the economy, demand for high-end lakefront luxury homes and high-density luxury condominiums in urban areas has shown a slowing trend. However, thanks to the region's diverse industrial base—particularly the concentration of high-income earners in the tech sector—the demand for homeownership in Greater Seattle remains strong. As a result, the pandemic has had a limited impact on the general housing market.

In response to attendees' interest in the Spring District, Jason shared his view that the area benefits from well-planned design, convenient commercial amenities, and excellent transportation connections, making it highly promising in the future market.

Millennials are expected to become the primary market for first-time homebuyers, with 46% of homebuyers in the Greater Seattle area belonging to this generation—representing a strong driving force for the residential market. Jason expressed an optimistic outlook on the medium-to-long-term prospects of the local residential market.

That evening, all attendees actively participated in the discussion and expressed their gratitude to the two guests from Windermere, who had thoroughly prepared ample materials for everyone. They had collected years of data and compiled them into professional charts, providing participants with a comprehensive understanding of the latest information on residential real estate investment in the Greater Seattle area.
items.body_zh:
本期做客嘉宾是来自西雅图房地产公司Windermere Real Estat/PSR Inc. 创始人Jason Moore，他与同事Laura Yang主持分享大西雅图地区住宅地产投资的最新信息。


在住宅市场交易中无论购买或销售，Windermere 公司的成交量占据本地市场总额的近四分之一。

Jason提到当本地住宅市场的库存超过3个月，可以认为是买方市场。最近一次的买方市场发生在2011年，自从上次房地产反弹后，由于市场房源短缺，大西雅图地区的住宅市场维持在卖方市场。 受到疫情和经济的影响，湖边高端豪宅或市区高密度高级公寓的需求体现放缓的趋势。然而，大西雅图由于产业多样化，特别是集中高科技企业的高收入人群，对购房的需求迫切，因此疫情对普通住房市场影响有限。针对朋友们关注的Spring District, Jason认为当地规划设计完善，周围商业、交通便利，今后极具市场潜力。

千禧一代将成为刚需购房的主要市场，大西雅图地区46%购房者为千禧一代，因此对住宅市场是强劲的推动力。Jason对本地区住宅市场的中长期展望持乐观态度。


当晚大家积极参加讨论，并且感谢来自Windermere的两位嘉宾，他们认真为大家准备了充足的资料，收集了多年的数据，制作成专业的图表，让大家对大西雅图地区住宅地产投资的最新信息获得全面了解。

items.id: food-with-love-西雅图爱心午餐行动进入胜利冲刺
items.title_zh: Food With Love，西雅图爱心午餐行动进入胜利冲刺
items.body_en:
The Food with Love Program, which has drawn tremendous attention in the Seattle region, is making its final push after joining forces with the Washington State China Relations Fund (WSCRF) and Tsinghua GIX North America.

As of May 31, the program has already exceeded its initial goal of $400,000 in meals and cash donations. Participating restaurants have donated 17,620 meals worth $320,000 and supporting parties and individuals contributed cash of $62,400, which was used to purchase 5,062 meals from the restaurants. As of today, a total of 20,878 meals have been delivered to 26 hospitals, testing sites, and police stations. Before the program ends on June 30, 2020, 1,835 additional meals will be delivered to sites in King County, which will conclude the program by successfully providing 22,713 meals.

With the initial stage of the Food with Love program has been successfully completed, CCCWA, WSRF, and Tsinghua GIX (all three non-profits organizations) together kicked off the second phase of this program:  “You help them, we’ll help you!” The program calls for all corners of society to continue to donate and support those restaurants that have already enthusiastically participated in this effort. As we all know, the restaurant industry has suffered unprecedented costs from Covid-19. Even in this situation, restaurants have still stepped forward and helped others. The motivation of these restaurant owners is pure and simple—they deeply care about this city and want to put forth their best effort as members of their communities. They make gourmet and nutritious meals without consideration of costs, repeatedly every day as if they were in a  gastronomical competition. These activities are actually elevating and raising awareness of Chinese gourmet culture, making more people love and appreciate Chinese food.

 With so many of their restaurants closing in China, Imperial Garden continues to persevere and be generous, passionately caring for those frontline workers battling Covid-19.

IJ Sushi Burrito, which had originally temporarily closed, decided to stay open and prepare meals just for the Food with Love program.  Many beneficiaries of these donations have expressed how deeply they were moved by such kindness.

Husband and wife Leo and Lucy, owners of Frying Fish, started their business from scratch and have worked hard for many years in the Seattle region. Even during a sudden 70% drop in business, “helping others is a kind of priceless happiness and fortune. We want to contribute as much as we can, and pull back only when we can’t hold on any longer.”

The young owner of Chengdu Memory, Laura, despite a daily busy schedule that doesn’t grant her enough sleep, still makes beautiful and creative cakes for hospital workers with her own hands.


On June 8, the WSCRF deposited checks for nearly $24,000 into this charitable program. According to WSCRF and WSCRC President J. Norwell Coquillard, “The Washington State China Relations Fund is pleased to support this highly innovative and meaningful effort to support both our business community and those workers who are on the front line of the battle against Covid-19.  We are very pleased that our members and friends stepped up to help make this program a success. We enjoyed the opportunity to work with CCCWA and Tsinghua GIX and look forward to more cooperation in the future.”

Initiated by CCCWA, the Dolar Shop Restaurant, and IJ Sushi Burrito, the program recruited 13 restaurants to prepare meals, which are delivered to beneficiaries including frontline healthcare professionals, police, and firefighters by Chowbus. The program would not have been possible without the generous donations from these participating restaurants. As explained by CCCWA President Lu Lili: “We choose to stand together when facing a common crisis. A little love from everyone combined becomes a lot of love. We’re one community, united.”

At the start of the program, six well-known restaurants—the Dolar Shop, IJ Sushi Burrito, Liuyishou Hotpot, Frying Fish, Imperial Garden, and Chengdu Memory—promised to fully donate meals valued at $242,000. Shortly thereafter, more restaurants joined the program, including Sizzling Pot King, Little Sheep, J&J Chinese Restaurant, Shanghai House, Panda Dimsum, Number 9 Alley Pot King, Jingjing Market, and Tamarindos. Throughout the entire process, more  organizations and volunteers have continuously signed up to help.

Tsinghua GIX North American Managing Director Guo Wenyan said that: “Since Tsinghua GIX was founded in the Seattle area in early 2016, we’ve actively participated in innovation and education activities in Washington state. During the Covid-19 crisis, it’s been even more important for us to leave the classroom and join the fight against the pandemic. We’re thrilled to be able to partner with the CCCWA and WSCRF to promote the Food with Love Program and do such down-to-earth activities to support frontline doctors, nurses, and service providers, our favorite restaurants that have been deeply impacted, and people who need help. Please support this program!”

 

About WSCRF


The WSCRF is a Washington nonprofit educational organization, recognized as tax exempt under Section 501(c)(3) of the IRS. As a new sister entity of the Washington State China Relations Council (WSCRC), the oldest non-governmental organization advocating at the state level for increased trade connections with China, WSCRF works closely with WSCRC to promote educational and charitable programs, exchanges, and understanding between the State of Washington and China.

 

About Tsinghua GIX North America


Tsinghua GIX Institute North America, a nonprofit organization incorporated in the State of Washington, is the representative of Tsinghua University to participate in GIX collaborations, to promote and operate Tsinghua University education programs in the North America. Our mission is to prepare the next generation of Chinese and American innovators, entrepreneurs to tackle the world's most challenging problems through global collaboration and technological innovation.

西雅图地区抗疫以来备受瞩目的“爱心午餐行动”，随着华中基金会WSCRF和清华GIX北美中心的联袂加入，已经正式走向胜利冲刺阶段。

这次公益行动最初目标是向一线抗疫人员送出价值40万美元的爱心餐，截至5月31日已超额完成 ---- 餐厅全额捐餐17,620份，价值约32万美元；后续募集现金6.24万美元，已向餐厅购餐5,062份。目前总共已送出20,878份，到达26个医疗机构、警察消防等一线抗疫机构以及需要救助的社区人员手中。最近还将送出1,835份，合计送出22,713份，总价值40.5万美元。

爱心午餐行动第一阶段胜利完成，CCCWA，WSCRF和清华GIX三个非盈利机构又联合发起第二阶段行动：“你们帮助他们，我们帮助你们！” 行动呼吁社会各界继续捐款支持已经参与热心义捐的餐厅，用所得善款补贴他们所捐餐食的部分成本。众所周知，餐饮业在此次新冠疫情中遭受了前所未有的重创。在这种情况下，餐厅们依然挺身而出帮助别人。餐厅老板们的愿望简单又朴素，他们深爱这个城市，希望作为社区的一员尽到自己的力量。他们不计成本地做出美味又营养的食物，仿佛每天在进行厨艺大赛。这个特殊的行动，实际上也传播了中华美食文化，让更多的人爱上了中餐。

颐和园北京烤鸭，在多个国内连锁店关闭的情况下，仍然咬紧牙关，慷慨解囊，以一片热诚关爱前线抗疫人员。

IJ Sushi Burrito在这段时间里本来暂停营业，他们是专门为了爱心行动，来到店里辛勤工作。不少受赠人员表示非常感动。

沸腾鱼乡的Leo和Lucy夫妇白手起家，在西雅图地区努力奋斗多年。这次在营业额骤降70%的情况下，仍然表示：“能够帮助到别人，是一种金钱买不到的快乐和幸福。希望出一份自己的力，能出多少就出多少，到最后如果我们撑不下去的时候再撤下来。”

蓉城老火锅的青年老板娘Laura，每天忙得睡眠不足情况下，仍然坚持免费为医护人员亲手制作精美而创意无限的蛋糕。


6月8日，WSCRF将他们新近募集的24,100美元，以支票形式汇聚到行动善款中。WSCRF和WSCRC会长J. Norwell Coquillard先生表示：“华中基金会很高兴参与并支持‘爱心餐’这个既有创新性又有意义的活动。在为抗击Covid-19的一线人员供餐的同时，也支持当地的餐饮企业。我们感谢WSCRC的会员和朋友，为本活动的成功积极做出贡献。我们也很高兴能和CCCWA以及清华GIX合作，期待今后有更多的合作机会。”

爱心午餐行动于今年3月由华州中国总商会CCCWA和豆捞坊中餐厅、IJ Sushi Burrito发起，由本地区13家餐厅精心制作午餐，通过专业外卖平台chowbus派送给抗疫前线的医护人员、警察和消防员。CCCWA会长吕莉莉女士说：“面对共同的危机，我们选择站在一起。每个人的小爱心，汇集成整体的大爱心，我们是一个社区，一个整体。”

在行动的最初阶段，豆捞坊、IJ Sushi Burrito，刘一手火锅、沸腾鱼乡、颐和园北京烤鸭店和蓉城老火锅等6家知名餐厅承诺并全额捐赠了价值24.2万美元的爱心套餐。接着又有芙蓉湘、小肥羊、百味轩、上海味道坊、熊猫点心、九号巷火锅、晶晶外卖和Tamarindos等多家中餐厅、印度餐厅、泰餐厅和越南餐厅加入。整个过程中，也不断有协办组织和志愿者陆续加入行动。

清华GIX北美中心负责人郭文艳表示：“清华GIX自2016年底在西雅图成立以来，一向积极组织参与华州的创新教育活动。新冠疫情之下，我们更要走出教室，积极参与社区抗疫。很高兴这次与CCCWA和WSCRF合作，一起推动爱心行动，为工作在前线的医生、护士、服务人员，为深受影响的我们热爱的中餐和其他餐厅，为所有需要帮助的人们，踏踏实实做些事情。请大家支持我们的行动！”


关于WSCRF


华中基金会是华中理事会（WSCRC）的姐妹组织，旨在同华中理事会紧密合作，增进华盛顿州和中国之间的教育文化交流与互相了解。WSCRC是美国州级历史最悠久的促进中美关系的非盈利组织。


关于清华GIX北美中心


清华GIX北美中心基于Global Innovation Exchange（GIX）全球创新项目合作的需求而建立，是注册于美国华盛顿州的非盈利组织。全球创新学院（GIX），是两所世界顶尖研究型大学----中国的清华大学与美国的华盛顿大学，在微软公司支持下，合作搭建的具有多元文化优势的开放性教育和科研平台，致力于培养具有全球视野和创新精神的领军人才，探索解决一系列包括可持续发展、移动医疗在内的各类全球性挑战。

西雅图地区抗疫以来备受瞩目的“爱心午餐行动”，随着华中基金会WSCRF和清华GIX北美中心的联袂加入，已经正式走向胜利冲刺阶段。

这次公益行动最初目标是向一线抗疫人员送出价值40万美元的爱心餐，截至5月31日已超额完成 ---- 餐厅全额捐餐17,620份，价值约32万美元；后续募集现金6.24万美元，已向餐厅购餐5,062份。目前总共已送出20,878份，到达26个医疗机构、警察消防等一线抗疫机构以及需要救助的社区人员手中。最近还将送出1,835份，合计送出22,713份，总价值40.5万美元。

content_blocks.en: With the initial stage of the Food with Love program has been successfully completed, CCCWA, WSRF, and Tsinghua GIX (all three non-profits organizations) together kicked off the second phase of this program:  “You help them, we’ll help you!” The program calls for all corners of society to continue to donate and support those restaurants that have already enthusiastically participated in this effort. As we all know, the restaurant industry has suffered unprecedented costs from Covid-19. Even in this situation, restaurants have still stepped forward and helped others. The motivation of these restaurant owners is pure and simple—they deeply care about this city and want to put forth their best effort as members of their communities. They make gourmet and nutritious meals without consideration of costs, repeatedly every day as if they were in a  gastronomical competition. These activities are actually elevating and raising awareness of Chinese gourmet culture, making more people love and appreciate Chinese food.
content_blocks.zh: 爱心午餐行动第一阶段胜利完成，CCCWA，WSCRF和清华GIX三个非盈利机构又联合发起第二阶段行动：“你们帮助他们，我们帮助你们！” 行动呼吁社会各界继续捐款支持已经参与热心义捐的餐厅，用所得善款补贴他们所捐餐食的部分成本。众所周知，餐饮业在此次新冠疫情中遭受了前所未有的重创。在这种情况下，餐厅们依然挺身而出帮助别人。餐厅老板们的愿望简单又朴素，他们深爱这个城市，希望作为社区的一员尽到自己的力量。他们不计成本地做出美味又营养的食物，仿佛每天在进行厨艺大赛。这个特殊的行动，实际上也传播了中华美食文化，让更多的人爱上了中餐。

content_blocks.en: With so many of their restaurants closing in China, Imperial Garden continues to persevere and be generous, passionately caring for those frontline workers battling Covid-19.
content_blocks.zh: 颐和园北京烤鸭，在多个国内连锁店关闭的情况下，仍然咬紧牙关，慷慨解囊，以一片热诚关爱前线抗疫人员。

content_blocks.en: IJ Sushi Burrito, which had originally temporarily closed, decided to stay open and prepare meals just for the Food with Love program.  Many beneficiaries of these donations have expressed how deeply they were moved by such kindness.
content_blocks.zh: IJ Sushi Burrito在这段时间里本来暂停营业，他们是专门为了爱心行动，来到店里辛勤工作。不少受赠人员表示非常感动。

content_blocks.en: Husband and wife Leo and Lucy, owners of Frying Fish, started their business from scratch and have worked hard for many years in the Seattle region. Even during a sudden 70% drop in business, “helping others is a kind of priceless happiness and fortune. We want to contribute as much as we can, and pull back only when we can’t hold on any longer.”
content_blocks.zh: 沸腾鱼乡的Leo和Lucy夫妇白手起家，在西雅图地区努力奋斗多年。这次在营业额骤降70%的情况下，仍然表示：“能够帮助到别人，是一种金钱买不到的快乐和幸福。希望出一份自己的力，能出多少就出多少，到最后如果我们撑不下去的时候再撤下来。”

content_blocks.en:
The young owner of Chengdu Memory, Laura, despite a daily busy schedule that doesn’t grant her enough sleep, still makes beautiful and creative cakes for hospital workers with her own hands.


On June 8, the WSCRF deposited checks for nearly $24,000 into this charitable program. According to WSCRF and WSCRC President J. Norwell Coquillard, “The Washington State China Relations Fund is pleased to support this highly innovative and meaningful effort to support both our business community and those workers who are on the front line of the battle against Covid-19.  We are very pleased that our members and friends stepped up to help make this program a success. We enjoyed the opportunity to work with CCCWA and Tsinghua GIX and look forward to more cooperation in the future.”
content_blocks.zh:
蓉城老火锅的青年老板娘Laura，每天忙得睡眠不足情况下，仍然坚持免费为医护人员亲手制作精美而创意无限的蛋糕。


6月8日，WSCRF将他们新近募集的24,100美元，以支票形式汇聚到行动善款中。WSCRF和WSCRC会长J. Norwell Coquillard先生表示：“华中基金会很高兴参与并支持‘爱心餐’这个既有创新性又有意义的活动。在为抗击Covid-19的一线人员供餐的同时，也支持当地的餐饮企业。我们感谢WSCRC的会员和朋友，为本活动的成功积极做出贡献。我们也很高兴能和CCCWA以及清华GIX合作，期待今后有更多的合作机会。”

content_blocks.en: Initiated by CCCWA, the Dolar Shop Restaurant, and IJ Sushi Burrito, the program recruited 13 restaurants to prepare meals, which are delivered to beneficiaries including frontline healthcare professionals, police, and firefighters by Chowbus. The program would not have been possible without the generous donations from these participating restaurants. As explained by CCCWA President Lu Lili: “We choose to stand together when facing a common crisis. A little love from everyone combined becomes a lot of love. We’re one community, united.”
content_blocks.zh: 爱心午餐行动于今年3月由华州中国总商会CCCWA和豆捞坊中餐厅、IJ Sushi Burrito发起，由本地区13家餐厅精心制作午餐，通过专业外卖平台chowbus派送给抗疫前线的医护人员、警察和消防员。CCCWA会长吕莉莉女士说：“面对共同的危机，我们选择站在一起。每个人的小爱心，汇集成整体的大爱心，我们是一个社区，一个整体。”

content_blocks.en: At the start of the program, six well-known restaurants—the Dolar Shop, IJ Sushi Burrito, Liuyishou Hotpot, Frying Fish, Imperial Garden, and Chengdu Memory—promised to fully donate meals valued at $242,000. Shortly thereafter, more restaurants joined the program, including Sizzling Pot King, Little Sheep, J&J Chinese Restaurant, Shanghai House, Panda Dimsum, Number 9 Alley Pot King, Jingjing Market, and Tamarindos. Throughout the entire process, more  organizations and volunteers have continuously signed up to help.
content_blocks.zh: 在行动的最初阶段，豆捞坊、IJ Sushi Burrito，刘一手火锅、沸腾鱼乡、颐和园北京烤鸭店和蓉城老火锅等6家知名餐厅承诺并全额捐赠了价值24.2万美元的爱心套餐。接着又有芙蓉湘、小肥羊、百味轩、上海味道坊、熊猫点心、九号巷火锅、晶晶外卖和Tamarindos等多家中餐厅、印度餐厅、泰餐厅和越南餐厅加入。整个过程中，也不断有协办组织和志愿者陆续加入行动。

content_blocks.en:
Tsinghua GIX North American Managing Director Guo Wenyan said that: “Since Tsinghua GIX was founded in the Seattle area in early 2016, we’ve actively participated in innovation and education activities in Washington state. During the Covid-19 crisis, it’s been even more important for us to leave the classroom and join the fight against the pandemic. We’re thrilled to be able to partner with the CCCWA and WSCRF to promote the Food with Love Program and do such down-to-earth activities to support frontline doctors, nurses, and service providers, our favorite restaurants that have been deeply impacted, and people who need help. Please support this program!”

 

About WSCRF


The WSCRF is a Washington nonprofit educational organization, recognized as tax exempt under Section 501(c)(3) of the IRS. As a new sister entity of the Washington State China Relations Council (WSCRC), the oldest non-governmental organization advocating at the state level for increased trade connections with China, WSCRF works closely with WSCRC to promote educational and charitable programs, exchanges, and understanding between the State of Washington and China.

 

About Tsinghua GIX North America


Tsinghua GIX Institute North America, a nonprofit organization incorporated in the State of Washington, is the representative of Tsinghua University to participate in GIX collaborations, to promote and operate Tsinghua University education programs in the North America. Our mission is to prepare the next generation of Chinese and American innovators, entrepreneurs to tackle the world's most challenging problems through global collaboration and technological innovation.
content_blocks.zh:
清华GIX北美中心负责人郭文艳表示：“清华GIX自2016年底在西雅图成立以来，一向积极组织参与华州的创新教育活动。新冠疫情之下，我们更要走出教室，积极参与社区抗疫。很高兴这次与CCCWA和WSCRF合作，一起推动爱心行动，为工作在前线的医生、护士、服务人员，为深受影响的我们热爱的中餐和其他餐厅，为所有需要帮助的人们，踏踏实实做些事情。请大家支持我们的行动！”


关于WSCRF


华中基金会是华中理事会（WSCRC）的姐妹组织，旨在同华中理事会紧密合作，增进华盛顿州和中国之间的教育文化交流与互相了解。WSCRC是美国州级历史最悠久的促进中美关系的非盈利组织。


关于清华GIX北美中心


清华GIX北美中心基于Global Innovation Exchange（GIX）全球创新项目合作的需求而建立，是注册于美国华盛顿州的非盈利组织。全球创新学院（GIX），是两所世界顶尖研究型大学----中国的清华大学与美国的华盛顿大学，在微软公司支持下，合作搭建的具有多元文化优势的开放性教育和科研平台，致力于培养具有全球视野和创新精神的领军人才，探索解决一系列包括可持续发展、移动医疗在内的各类全球性挑战。
